AI.method: MM-SAN 架构（Fig.1）含五步：①增强（离线）——用 DBpedia Spotlight（置信度 0.75）做实体链接、BERTopic（最小簇 2 篇，KeyBERT 标注）做主题建模，向 SKG 注入 topic 与 entity 两类新节点，作为枢纽连接原本互不相连的区域，主题提供全局连通性、实体提供局部内容相关性；每个节点得到 node2vec 结构嵌入与文本嵌入（长文本用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，短标签如主题/实体/关键词用 Phrase-BERT）。②采样——从目标节点出发做长度为 l 的随机游走（忽略边方向，假定反向边存在），按 sim_score(v_t, walk_j)= (1/m_j)Σ cos(v_t,v_i)/d(v_t,v_i) 选相似度最高的 k 条游走，再从 pub/dataset 组选 top-n 余弦相似节点、其余各类型选距目标最近的 n 个，每类型各 5 个邻居。③邻居分组——(i) 论文与数据集、(ii) 关键词/主题/实体、(iii) 作者/机构/会议。④聚合——对每组做交叉注意力：Q 取目标节点文本嵌入（线性投影），K/V 取邻居拓扑嵌入（线性投影），多头缩放点积注意力（8 头，128 维），实现"文本缺失时依赖拓扑、拓扑稀疏时依赖文本"的自适应权重。⑤组合——三组嵌入拼接得最终表示。训练用 mini-batch 梯度下降、负采样（每正例 5 负例）、交叉熵 sigmoid 损失（AdamW，lr 1e-5，batch 1024，最多 100 epoch 早停）。实验在 OAG 派生的 MES（策展）与 PubMed（未策展）上进行，划分 train/val/三个测试集：转导（全部节点可见）、半归纳（测试时出现新论文）、全归纳（新论文+新数据集，训练图中连同所有入射边一并移除以防泄漏），并在 100%/75%/50%/25% 元数据可用率下分别训练模型；评测用 Recall、nDCG、MRR @ k∈{5,10}；对比 15 个基线（归纳类：GAT、KGAT、SAGE、HGT、HAN、HGNN；转导类：ST-T、KGCN、MP2Vec、RGCN、VGAE、HVGAE、LSVM、DF、Ens）。消融覆盖增强（去实体/去主题）、采样（1~3 跳随机 vs 随机游走）、聚合（GRU/LSTM/MHA/线性投影）、组合（GRU/LSTM/MHA/均值池化）、编码器（DeepWalk+GloVe）、模态屏蔽（拓扑不可用 vs 文本不可用）以及作者为查询的扩展任务。
AI.result: ①三种学习场景全部领先：MM-SAN 在所有设置与指标上均为最佳图方法；MES 上 Trans[100%] R@5=0.727、nDCG@5=0.546、MRR@5=0.484，半归纳 R@5=0.719，全归纳 R@5=0.687；PubMed 上 Trans[100%] R@5=0.380，Semi 0.373，Ind 0.344。②元数据鲁棒性：25% 元数据下 MM-SAN 仍是最佳（MES 全归纳 R@5=0.453 vs HGNN 0.322，提升 41%；PubMed 全归纳 R@5=0.205 vs HGNN 0.129，提升 59%），是唯一在各设置中稳定保持 R@5>0.450(MES)、>0.200(PubMed) 的方法。③纯文本基线 ST-T 仅在"元数据 100% 且转导/半归纳"理想条件下最优（PubMed R@5=0.590），但元数据下降后急剧退化，无法用于真实场景；DataFinder 同理（MES 100% 时 0.420，25% 时 0.299）。④图基线普遍在稀疏关系上崩溃：HAN、HGT 接近 0（无法学稳定关系表示）、KGAT 仅在全元数据下 R@5>0.1、RGCN/KGCN/HVGAE 在 PubMed 上 <0.01、EnsembleCN 在 PubMed 上 ≤0.005（作者未消歧导致合著网络碎片化）。⑤配对 t 检验（α=0.05，逐查询）全部显著（p<0.05）。⑥消融：增强与采样均不可或缺（MES 去增强 R@5 0.727→0.642；MES 去掉实体降 0.676、去主题降 0.708；PubMed 相反，去主题降 0.329 幅度大于去实体 0.341，说明稀疏大图更依赖主题枢纽）；随机游走优于 1/2/3 跳随机采样；交叉注意力优于 GRU/LSTM/MHA/线性投影；拼接优于各类组合替代（均值池化最差，PubMed Trans R@5 仅 0.189）；node2vec+Transformer 编码器优于 DeepWalk+GloVe（差距在归纳+部分元数据时最大）。⑦模态消融显示双向补偿能力：掩蔽拓扑（MES Trans[50%] R@5=0.635）优于掩蔽文本（0.539），说明单模态下文本是更强后备信号；即使全文本缺失（[0%]）模型仍保持 R@5=0.395(MES)/0.198(PubMed)。⑧组件分析显示增强与随机游走采样可移植到基线（SAGE-RW 在 PubMed 归纳 nDCG 提升 51%，GAT-RW 提升 38%），但对同质模型（GAT/SAGE/HAN/HGT）反而引入噪声。⑨作者为查询的更难任务中 MM-SAN 仍最佳（MES Trans R@5=0.677 vs HGNN 0.567）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：MM-SAN 通过「增强—采样—交叉注意力聚合」三阶段流水线，首次在同一框架内统一处理 SKG 的异构性、结构稀疏、动态演化与元数据不完整，证明了结构与文本双模态对科学数据集推荐是互补且必要的：文本直接编码出版—数据集语义相关性，拓扑在描述缺失时提供关系性替代证据。跨模态交叉注意力会依据可用性与信息量动态调节两模态权重，因此不依赖任何固定回退策略；基于推理时构建邻居表示（无节点专属参数）使同一模型可直接服务新增论文与数据集，无需重训练，适合 OAG 类持续增长的聚合器。实践上可集成到学术仓储、数字图书馆与数据集发现服务：投稿阶段向作者推荐候选数据集、为读者浮现相关数据集以促进复现与复用，主要贡献于 FAIR 中的可发现性并间接促进可复用性；但推荐应附最新的访问条件、许可证与溯源信息（访问请求、再分发/商用/衍生作品限制等），且归纳能力不免除真实部署所需的数据治理工作。未来工作：引入 mixture-of-experts 以更好利用高质量元数据（文本独占方法在理想条件下仍更强）、将 FAIR 相关可访问性/许可/互操作性元数据纳入推荐作为额外信号或约束，并扩展到基于会议/场所（venue）的推荐及不同节点类型的对比分析。

title: A King for Almost Everyone
summary: A tournament is an orientation of a complete graph. A vertex $v$ controls a vertex $u\neq v$ if there is a directed path of length at most two from $v$ to $u$, and a $\delta$-king is one that controls at least $\delta(n-1)$ vertices. In the query complexity model, each query reveals the orientation of an edge. Shen, Sheng and Wu [SICOMP'03] established an $\Omega(n^{4/3})$ lower bound on the deterministic query complexity of finding a $1$-king, and a non-matching upper bound of $O(n^{3/2})$. Neither bound has been improved in over two decades, despite substantial progress on variants of the problem. For $\delta$-kings with $\delta < 1$, Biswas, Jayapaul, Raman and Satti [Discrete Applied Mathematics'22] showed that $O(n^{4/3})$ queries suffice to find a $\frac12$-king. Lachish, Reidl and Trehan [FSTTCS'22] improved this guarantee to $\frac12+\frac{2}{17}$ using $\widetilde{O}(n^{4/3})$ queries, and asked whether a larger fraction could be achieved within the same query bound. We answer this question affirmatively for every fixed fraction below one: for every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, we give a deterministic algorithm that finds a $(1-\varepsilon)$-king using $O(n^{4/3})$ queries. The design of our algorithm is informed by a structural analysis combining a sparse regularity lemma due to Allen, Kohayakawa, Mota and Parente [Electronic Journal of Combinatorics'14] with a new sampling argument based on a reachability theorem of Afek, Gafni and Linial [arXiv'19].

AI.tldr: 本文在确定性查询模型下研究锦标赛中近似"王"（king）的寻找问题，取得突破性结果：对任意固定 ε∈(0,1)，均可用 O_ε(n^{4/3}) 次查询找到一个 (1−ε)-王。这与已知的 Ω_ε(n^{4/3}) 下界匹配，因而确定了该问题的最优确定性查询复杂度（对每个固定 ε 而言）。此前二十余年该问题上下界悬而未决（SICOMP'03 的 Ω(n^{4/3}) 下界与 O(n^{3/2}) 上界），近似版本也仅达 1/2 及 1/2+2/17。
AI.motivation: 锦标赛（tournament）中"王"指能通过长度至多 2 的有向路径到达所有其他顶点的顶点，是社会选择理论中未覆盖集（uncovered set）的核心对象。在查询复杂度模型下，每次查询仅能获知一条边的朝向。Shen–Sheng–Wu (SICOMP'03) 给出寻找 1-王的 Ω(n^{4/3}) 下界与 O(n^{3/2}) 上界，二十余年来无人改进；随机化情形下已知为 Θ(n)。为绕开这一长期悬案，作者转向松弛目标：能否用 n^{4/3} 量级查询找到一个控制几乎全部顶点的顶点？Biswas 等 (DAM'22) 达到 1/2，Lachish–Reidl–Trehan (FSTTCS'22) 在 Õ(n^{4/3}) 下达到 1/2+2/17，并明确提出开放问题：是否能在同一查询量级下取得更大的比例？本文正面回答该问题——任意固定的 1 以下的比例均可达成。
AI.method: 两阶段查询框架（沿用 Lachish 等的模板图思路，但更换结构工具）。第一阶段：事先固定一个边数 ≤ n^{4/3} 的稀疏无向"模板图"，用 G(n, n^{-2/3}) 随机图 + Chernoff/union bound 证明其存在性；关键性质是任意两个规模 ≥ κn 的不相交集合之间边数约为 n^{-2/3}|X||Y|。查询模板图全部边后：(a) 用 Allen–Kohayakawa–Mota–Parente 的稀疏 Szemerédi 正则性引理把顶点划分为 O_η(1) 个等大组加一个 O(ηn) 的例外组，两方向几乎处处"正则"；(b) 依组间弧密度多数方向构造"组图"R（近乎锦标赛），并用 Gerke–Kohayakawa–Rödl–Steger 的稀疏下正则"继承定理"在每组内随机选取大小 Θ_ε(n^{2/3}) 的"court"，保证 R 中弧 i→j 时 court_i 的任意 η 比例子集几乎支配 V_j 全部顶点。第二阶段：查询 courts 并集 Q（|Q|=O_ε(n^{2/3})）所诱导的子锦标赛 S；用 Afek–Gafni–Linial 的"双锦标赛定理"结合随机抽样论证证明存在顶点 w，其"激活组"在 R 中的出邻域覆盖至少 (1−2τ)r 个组；由 court 性质，w 经 S 的弧加模板图的弧两步即可到达这些组中几乎所有顶点。参数取 τ=ε/8、η≤τ，得 |N^{++}_T(w)| ≥ (1−ε)n。查询代价：n^{4/3} + O_ε(n^{4/3}) = O_ε(n^{4/3})。模板密度 p 的选取由总代价 Θ_ε(n^2 p + p^{-2}) 在 p = n^{-2/3} 处平衡决定。
AI.result: 定理 1：对每个固定 ε∈(0,1)，存在确定性算法以 O_ε(n^{4/3}) 次查询找到 (1−ε)-王。结合 Ajtai–Feldman–Hassidim–Nelson 对 Shen–Sheng–Wu 对手的分析（该对手需 Ω(t^{4/3}) 查询才能找到控制 t 个顶点的顶点），取 t=⌈(1−ε)(n−1)⌉ 得匹配下界 Ω_ε(n^{4/3})，故对每个固定 ε 该问题复杂度被确定为 Θ_ε(n^{4/3})。附带推论 11：同样的 O_ε(n^{4/3}) 查询可推广到双锦标赛版本——找到在 T_1 的弧接 T_2 的弧（或反序）意义下到达至少 (1−ε)(n−1) 个顶点的顶点。方法学上，作者亦披露使用 ChatGPT Astra 辅助识别引理 14 与定理 13、并做数学校对与行文润色。
AI.conclusion: 本文回答了 Lachish、Reidl 与 Trehan 提出的主要开放问题：任意固定的 1 以下比例的近似王都可在 O(n^{4/3}) 查询内确定性地找到，并给出匹配下界，从而确定了该问题的最优复杂度。遗留问题包括：(1) 能否用 O(n^{4/3}) 次查询找到完整的 1-王（难点在于判定某顶点是否为王本身需 Ω(n^2) 查询；作者提出将"未认证顶点集合"降至 O_ε(n^{2/3}) 的可能路线，但现有论证遗留 εn 个未认证点，且常数依赖 ε，故无法令 ε 随 n 变小）；(2) 更强下界需区分"到达全部顶点"与"到达任意接近 1 的固定比例"；(3) 算法目前非时间高效（模板图、分组与 courts 的存在性均为存在性论证，查询模型下计算免费），存在设计 O_ε(n^{4/3}) 时间算法的开放问题；(4) 改进对 ε 的依赖关系可能有助于解决完整王的问题。

title: A Family of Well-Behaved Multiflow Instances
comment: To appear in SOSA 2027. 10 pages, 2 figures
summary: We introduce a family of cut-sufficient instances for undirected multiflow that generalizes single-source planar and fully-planar instances. We also show the family has an additive $6 d_{\max}$ error for converting a fractional flow into an unsplittable one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"星平面"（stellar-planar）实例族——由平面基图 K 的每条边替换为一个以该边端点为源、且两端点都在外部面上的平面单源子实例（"patch"）而成——它是割充分（cut-sufficient）的，因而可推广单源平面与完全平面实例：割条件成立即可行，整数数据下存在半整流，满足 Euler 条件时存在整流；并且任何可行实例都存在不可分流（unsplittable）解，其边负载至多超出容量 6d_max。
AI.motivation: 经典多商品流（multiflow）不满足割条件即可行的性质，且最大流最小割与整性会被严重违反。单源实例则享有割充分、整性以及 d_max 的低误差不可分流等优良性质，但单源限制太强。为此已有大量"割充分族"（如完全平面实例、需求跨一两个面的平面实例、串并联图等），每个族通常伴随半整性保证。低误差不可分流方面已有外平面 2d_max、完全平面 2d_max 等结果。已有工作的证明（如 fully-compliant 串并联）往往技术繁琐、依赖 ear 压缩等复杂操作，缺乏统一易懂的切入点。作者希望给出一个统一框架：用一种结构清晰的"补丁（patch）"分解，同时涵盖并推广单源平面实例与完全平面实例，并给出带界的不可分流误差。
AI.method: 方法核心是"2-割归约"（取自 [6] 的 Lemma 1）与"钉扎"（pinning）两种技术。(1) 割充分性：定义 deficit(ℐ,S)=d(δ_H(S))−u(δ_G(S)) 及 ab-亏损；沿 patch 的 2-割 {a,b} 把实例分裂为 ℐ(C) 与 ℐ(C̄)，利用 Lemma 1 在两侧之间"搬运"亏损——在缺陷侧加 a-b 供给边、在富余侧加 a-b 需求边——从而使两个子实例都满足割条件（且保持 Euler 条件），再对"非平凡 patch 数"做归纳：若所有 patch 均平凡则退化为完全平面实例（用 Seymour 结果），否则用单源子实例的可行性与归纳假设粘合出整流；a-b 亏损可通过割条件检查（LP）+二分搜索在多项式时间内计算。(2) 不可分流：利用"钉扎"操作把需求 h=st 拆成 s-y1,y1-y2,…,yk-t 的序列。先证明对"友好"（friendly）实例存在 good pinning，使每条需求边要么与供给边平行、要么连接某 patch 的两个附着节点，从而 G+H' 平面，且容量仅增加 2d_max（Theorem 4，通过选取无外部流穿越的 patch、在 B 中沿 a-b 路径转移误差）；再证明一般实例可先经两步预处理变为友好实例：①把不连通的 patch 供给图拆成多个 patch（对 a-p 需求钉扎为 a-b, b-p）；②对"坏 patch"（其他 patch 的流穿越其中）加入容量为 γ 的 a-b 新供给边并相应下调原边容量，使流改走新边；最后把新边的误差再转回原 patch，得容量增加 4d_max（Theorem 5）。于是钉扎后实例为完全平面型，可用 [1] 的 2d_max 不可分流结果，二者相加得 6d_max。
AI.result: 定理 1（割充分与整性）：若星平面实例满足割条件 u(δ_G(X))≥d(δ_H(X))，则可行；u,d 为整数时存在半整可行流；若每个顶点处供给容量与需求值之和为偶数（Euler 条件），则存在整可行流。定理 2（不可分流）：任何可行的星平面实例都存在不可分流解 y，满足 y(e)≤u(e)+6d_max 对所有供给边成立。定理 3 给出定理 1 中整流部分的完整归纳证明（含"全平凡 patch 即完全平面实例"的退化情形）；定理 4、5 分别给出友好情形的 2d_max 钉扎与一般情形的 4d_max 钉扎，且所有存在性定理均可转为多项式时间算法（亏损值用二分+割条件判定计算）。文中还指出并修正了 [6] 中 Lemma 3.3 的一个奇偶性/Euler 条件保持性缺陷（两个亏损皆为负的情形）。作者称受益于星平面结构的清晰性，完整证明比相关文献更短、更易理解，可作为该系列工作的入门读物。
AI.conclusion: 星平面实例是一个新的割充分多商品流族，同时推广单源平面实例与完全平面实例，并继承二者的半整性；在不可分流流方面得到 6d_max 的加性误差界（优于通用实例，且与外平面/完全平面的 2d_max 结果同数量级）。文中同时给出了可行性与不可分流流的构造性/多项式时间算法框架，以及基于"补丁分解 + 2-割归约 + 钉扎"的证明技术，可望成为理解割充分与低误差不可分流流相关文献的良好切入点。展望部分作者认为可进一步证明星平面实例具有"不可交叉性"（uncrossability），从而借 [5] 的结果继承最大边不相交路径（MEDP）的常数因子近似算法；作者还指出最终目标是推广到"fully-compliant series-parallel"等更一般的拓扑割充分实例族。

title: The Hyperclique Hypothesis is False
summary: The Hyperclique Hypothesis postulates that, for all constants $k > h \geq 3$, detecting a $k$-clique in an $h$-uniform hypergraph with $n$ vertices requires time $n^{k-o(1)}$. This hypothesis is false: there is an algebraic algorithm that detects (and even counts) $k$-cliques in $h$-uniform hypergraphs in time $O(n^{(1-\epsilon_h)k})$. Via known reductions, this also refutes the recently proposed $k$-AP Hypothesis. As a consequence, many problems with conditional lower bounds based on these two hypotheses may admit faster algorithms after all. This result is almost entirely due to AI.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了超团假设（Hyperclique Hypothesis）：对任意常数 k > h ≥ 3，存在代数算法在 O(n^{(1−ε_h)k}) 时间内检测（甚至计数）h-一致超图中的 k-团，并进一步反驳 k-AP 假设。作者声明本结果几乎完全由 AI（ChatGPT Astra 6、Claude Opus 5.5）在极少人工输入下完成。
AI.motivation: 超团假设由 Lincoln、Vassilevska Williams 与 Williams 提出，断言在 h ≥ 3 时检测 h-一致超图中的 k-团必须耗时 n^{k−o(1)}，因此是过去十余年大量条件性下界的基石（中维正交向量、稀疏环/超环检测、诱导 4-环检测、近似 n-pairs 最短路、有界树宽模式子图同构、DAG 中的最近公共祖先、一阶模型检查与布尔 CSP、Klee 测度问题、几何交图直径、离散 k-中心、L∞ Hausdorff 距离、4-SUM 等）。此前已有 3SUM、APSP、ETH 等核心硬度假设被代数算法在数周内推翻的先例，作者因此主张：既然假设只是"当前算法前沿的标记"，就应先尝试推翻它，而不是把它当教条。本文的动机即检验并推翻超团假设（并顺带检验近期提出的 k-AP 假设）。
AI.method: 将组合问题代数化为超团多项式求值 H_{k,h} = Σ_{x∈[n]^k} Π_{S∈C([k],h)} A_{S;x_S}（取 0/1 数组时等于 k-团数的 k! 倍），只需处理 k = h+1（通过把 k 个变量分成 h+1 块降维）。作者识别出两条既有"代数障碍"：(1) 张量秩障碍——H_3 的张量秩与边界秩均为 n^4，单纯的"四个线性形式相乘再求和"的秩方法无法优于穷举；(2) 张量网络障碍——Austrin–Kaski–Kubjas 证明张量网络模型（固定求值树）下 H_3 的任何算法需 Ω(n^4)。绕行策略是"对不同项混用不同求值顺序"：用双线性推广的 Cauchy–Binet 型 swap identity 把 H_3 改写成许多更小多项式的带符号和（q 个 main 项与 C(q,2) 个 correction 项），再对每一项选取 (AB)(CD) 或 (BC)(DA) 中更便宜的配对求值；一般 h 的情形引入矩阵值数组的辅助超团多项式 T_h（规模 (N,M,a,b,c)），对 y,z（以及 x,w）的 base-q 末位数字做分治，main 项把数字并入 a 或 b 维、correction 项把 c 维加倍，系数仅为 ±1 因而整数不会膨胀；基例用 Strassen 快速矩阵乘（h=3）与归纳调用 H_{h−1}（一般 h，给出三种配对方案取最快），并以势函数 (abc)^{1−δ} 与 ρ = q^{−δ} + (1−1/q)2^{−δ} 分析总时间，ε ≥ (δ − log₂(1+(2/q)^δ))/log₂ q，最后由 k-AP 归约（h = k−1）得出 k-AP 检测算法。
AI.result: 主定理（Thm 1.1/2.1）：对每个常数 h ≥ 2 存在 ε_h > 0，使任意常数 k > h 的 k-团检测与计数可在 O(n^{(1−ε_h)k}) 时间内完成；h = 3 时具体为 O(n^{3.99999})，若利用最优方阵/矩形矩阵乘界并更精细分析递归可改进到 O(n^{3.9583})。由此推翻 k-AP 假设：任意 k ≥ 3 的非平凡 k-AP 可在 O(N^{2−ε_k}) 时间内检测。直接推论包括：Max-h-SAT（n 变量）可解于 O*(2^{(1−δ_h)n})，此前 h ≥ 3 时无任何超越穷举的改进；度至多 h 的布尔 Max-CSP 同样可改进；k > 2h 时 Zero-Weight 与 Min-Weight k-Clique 获得多项式级改进；Densest k-Subhypergraph、Partial Vertex Cover、加权 k-布尔 CSP、k > h 的 (k,h)-Orthogonal Vectors 及部分一阶优化问题获得更快算法；还能以 O(n^{(1−ε_h)k}) 计数任意固定 k-顶点模式的诱导/非诱导拷贝。相关工作中作为"超图代数困难性路线"的两切片秩（two-slice rank）被证明为 O(n^{4−ε}) 而非 Ω(n^4)。同时说明：数据库理论中仅排除"超边数近线性"时间的更弱假设未被反驳；ε_h = Ω(ε_{h−1}^4/log(1/ε_{h−1})) 随 h 双重指数衰减，作者未优化常数。
AI.conclusion: 超团假设为假，超图问题的代数复杂度前沿再度前移；大量以超团假设与 k-AP 假设为前提的条件性下界失去依据，相关问题（如原 3SUM-hard 几何问题、有限代数结构中的恒等式验证等）重新开放，有望出现更快算法。方法论上，"把计数写成许多项的带符号和、为每项单独选择最省乘法顺序并递归"这一思路与近期对 ETH 的反驳（Anthropic、OpenAI）同源，说明张量秩/张量网络类代数障碍假设可能被系统性地重新检验；后续工作应包括优化 ε_h 对 h 的依赖、并考察该技术对其他张量秩类假设的可推广性。

title: On the optimality of truncation among binary linear sketches
summary: We study statistical inference and function evaluation problems in which the input binary vector is available only through a binary linear sketch, i.e., a fixed number of parity measurements. We show that under a certain monotonicity condition, simply truncating the input by retaining a subset of its coordinates is optimal among all linear sketches of the same size. In particular, this applies to distributed testing of correlations of binary vectors when they are of opposite signs and evaluating unate Boolean functions on uniformly random inputs. Additionally, given that truncation is optimal, we immediately have lower bounds for arbitrary binary linear sketches. To illustrate this application, we consider the one-way communication complexity of a distributional graph connectivity problem on $n$ vertices and show that truncation, and hence all binary linear sketches, requires $\Theta(n \log n)$ bits to achieve constant error, while a nonlinear protocol only requires $O(\log n)$ bits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"二进制线性草图"（F₂ 上的线性草图，即若干次奇偶校验）下的统计推断与函数求值问题，证明在一种"反向单调性"条件下，最优的线性草图就是最简单的截断（保留部分坐标）。这一结论适用于：① 两个相关系数符号相反的二进制向量之间的分布式相关性检验（解决作者先前的猜想）；② 在均匀随机输入上求值单态（unate）布尔函数。由此可立即得到任意线性草图的下界。作者据此给出一个示例：分布式图连通性单向通信问题中，截断乃至所有线性草图需 Θ(n log n) 比特，而非线性协议只需 O(log n) 比特。
AI.motivation: 线性草图（尤其是 F₂ 上的二进制线性草图）是空间受限与通信受限场景下的核心工具，可聚合、可增量更新，并在流式算法与哈希/随机性提取中被广泛研究。此前工作表明线性草图对"模2和"的恢复是最优的（Körner–Marton），这自然让人期待它在相关性推断上同样表现出色；作者前作 [24] 已证明当相关系数等幅反号或其中之一为零时，任何二进制线性草图都不优于平凡地保留相同坐标子集，并猜想"任意反号相关对"均成立，本文即解决该猜想。另一方面，Ancheta [9] 与 Courtade–Kumar 相关工作表明截断在有损压缩、互信息意义下是最优的，这提示需要更一般的决策论（Blackwell 支配）刻画与任意草图维度 k 的最优性结果。
AI.method: 核心技术是 Blackwell 支配（用转移核刻画，并通过所有 f-散度的数据处理不等式等价刻画）。不失一般性把秩 k 的草图写成 x_I ⊕ Ã x_{I^c}（I 为信息集），然后证明截断 x_I 支配混合统计量 x_I ⊕ V：具体地，①先用"同一直线草图优于不同草图"的核（生成均匀 W 并置 U=AZ、W 无关）把问题化为单草图问题；②证明 Proposition 2（独立相加有害）：当 p₀、p₁ 分处 1/2 两侧时 U ⪰ U⊕V，用凸性把任意随机 V 归约到确定性 v（Lemma 1），再对单比特显式构造随机核 K（Lemma 2），并逐坐标独立应用；③提出一般化的 Proposition 3（反向单调性）：若条件联合分布 P(U,V) 在 u 的每个坐标上分别非增/非减，则 U ⪰ U⊕V，其证明逐坐标用 E_γ-散度、凸性 z↦[z]₊ 逐项比较；④单态性蕴含该单调性，从而得 Theorem 2；⑤应用：图连通性中用 Fourier 分析证明方差缩减引理 Var(E[f|Z_I]) ≤ (|I|/m)Var(f)，配合 p→1/e 给出 k ≥ m/2 的下界，并用"发送孤立右顶点标签"的非线性协议给 O(log n) 上界。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) Theorem 1——当 ρ₀ρ₁ ≤ 0（p₀、p₁ 分处 1/2 两侧）时，Alice/Bob 各自发送相同 k = min{k_A,k_B} 个坐标（截断）在 Blackwell 意义下支配任意二进制线性草图，因而在 I 类/II 类错误上均不劣（同时证明双方使用同一草图总是更优，且更强者成立：截断无法被任何与截断坐标独立的信息改进）。(2) Theorem 2——对均匀随机输入上的单态布尔函数 f，任意秩 k 草图 AZ 的最小误差不优于截断到 k 个坐标，故 min_{rank A=k} e_f(AZ) = min_{|I|=k} e_f(Z_I)；非单态则失效（如 f = z₁⊕z₂ 时线性草图可精确求值，截断错误率 1/2）。(3) Theorem 3——完全二部图 K_{v,2^v}（n = v+2^v 顶点、m = v2^v 边）的分布式连通性：存在使用 3v+3 = O(log n) 比特的确定性非线性协议，对每个 H 误差 ≤ 1/10；而任何 k 比特线性草图需 k ≥ m/2 = Ω(n log n)。
AI.conclusion: 截断在满足"反向单调性"这一充分条件的所有问题中是最优二进制线性草图，这既给出概念上最简单的最优方案，也把对一般线性草图（涉及大量重叠奇偶）的下界分析简化为对截断的分析，从而干净地证明了线性草图严格次优于非线性编码器的实例（开销因子可达 Ω(n)）。文中亦说明结果对每个固定矩阵成立，可推广到与输入独立的共享随机性设定。开放问题：精确刻画使截断最优的相关对集合 R_{k,n}（数值实验显示 k,n→∞ 时收缩至反号区域）、寻找更一般的结构刻画（如条件分布的 Fourier 结构），以及识别何种条件下常数因子开销足以让线性草图匹配任意编码器。

title: A Constant-Factor Approximation for Capacitated Facility Location with Outliers
summary: We give a deterministic polynomial-time $(60/11+\eps)$-approximation for metric capacitated facility location with outliers, with arbitrary opening costs and nonuniform hard capacities. The algorithm respects both capacities and the outlier budget. Its guarantee, approximately $5.455$, is close to the best known factor $5+\eps$ for capacitated facility location without outliers. The main ingredient is a local-search comparison for a common rejection penalty that retains the signed difference between the algorithm's and the comparator's rejection counts. Ordinary approximation guarantees for the penalty objective do not provide this comparison. We extend the exchange-forest accounting of Bansal, Garg, and Gupta \cite{BGG18} so that a nonnegative assignment remainder pays for rejection and cancels in the final bound. We then merge two penalty assignments whose served counts bracket the outlier quota. Grouping alternating paths by their terminal facility preserves capacities and shares opening costs. These ingredients give a $(20/3+\eps)$-approximation; starting each penalty run from the preceding solution improves the guarantee to $60/11+\eps$.

AI.tldr: 本文给出度量空间下带异常值（允许最多 L=n−q 个客户不被服务）的容量设施选址（CFLO）问题的确定性多项式时间 (60/11+ε)-近似算法（≈5.455），支持任意设施开启费用与非一致硬容量，输出解同时满足容量约束与异常值配额。核心是"带符号的惩罚比较"不等式 c(S)+3λ(q−|C_S|) ≤ 5·OPT+δ，以及两个惩罚解的匹配式合并与热启动下降分析。
AI.motivation: 带异常值的容量设施选址（CFLO）同时要求满足硬容量与"最少服务客户数 q"（等价于至多 L=n−q 个离群点）两个约束，二者相互耦合：异常值的选择改变容量需求的位置，设施的选择又改变哪些客户昂贵。已有结果要么放松容量或配额约束（如 Dabas–Gupta 允许小规模违约），要么假设设施开启费用一致（Gupta–Dabas–Garg 的 6.373+ε，Friggstad–Wu 的 3+ε）。任意开启费用带来额外困难：仅控制开启设施的数量无法防止对同一昂贵设施的重复计费，因而必须逐个控制新开设施的费用。此外，对带惩罚（prize-collecting）目标的黑盒近似保证（如把 CFL 的 5-因子当作黑盒）只能给出 c(S)+λ(q−|C_S|) ≤ 5OPT+4λ(n−q)，在取平均消去左侧惩罚项后右侧留下不可控项，无法用于配额恢复。
AI.method:
框架：以统一拒绝惩罚 λ 替代离群点硬约束，最小化 Φ_λ(S)=c(S)+λr(S)；在惩罚网格 λ=kη 上迭代局部搜索，每轮从上一轮解热启动，直到服务客户数首次达到 q。
(1) 带符号比较（Thm 2.1）：扩展 Bansal–Garg–Gupta 的交换森林（exchange forest）及其 up/down 分解以容纳"拒绝"这一非度量端点。为每个源设施挂一个私有"处置叶"表示拒绝（按 λ 计费，不走度量路径），从赋值路径分解中隔离出非负余量 D，使度量传输与拒绝的总费用 ≤ c_s(S)+c_s(O)+D；而赋值比较贡献 −D（系数 2−3=−1），故拒绝的"付费"在最终界中完全抵消，得到 c(S)+3λ(q−|C_S|) ≤ 5·OPT+6mτ（δ=6mτ 为可容差）。关键技术点：由于 G_t 可能带符号，需通过补足 (5−a_t) 份 add 比较得到 κ_t = 5−β_t/û(t) ≥ 3，从而保持不等式方向正确。
(2) 合并两个惩罚解（Lemma 2.2）：把设施拆成带标签的容量槽，两个赋值视为匹配，其对称差分解为交替路径与环；增广路径每次可多服务一个客户且保留原服务客户，仅终端设施需新开。按终端设施分组路径，使多客户共享一次开启费；按"每路径单价"排序取整组+至多一个部分组，服务成本不超过分数预算 θb，仅多付至多一个开启费 M，得到 min{b, a+θb+M}。
(3) 热启动下降（Sec 2.3）：令 H=5OPT+6mτ+3nη，t=λ⁺g。热启动给出 b ≤ a+t，带符号界给出 a ≤ H−3θt，于是 b 与 a+θb 的上界一增一减，交点值 H/(1−θ+3θ²) ≤ 12H/11，故合并解成本 ≤ (12/11)H+M，得 60/11·OPT。
(4) 吸收开启费：对每个设施猜测其为最优解中开启费最大的设施（设 M=f_{i0}，丢弃更贵者并把 i0 置为免费），配合代价尺度 B=ℓ2^j 猜测 OPT 的量级，取 τ=εB/(100m)、η=εB/(100n)、K=⌈4B/η⌉。
AI.result: 定理 1.1：对任意 0<ε≤1，度量 CFLO（任意开启费用、非一致硬容量）存在确定性的 (60/11+ε)-近似算法，运行时间关于输入二进制长度与 1/ε 多项式。证明链条为：带符号惩罚比较（系数 3）→ 合并引理给出 min{b, a+θb+M}，并用 1−θ+θ²≥3/4 得 20/3+ε；再利用热启动关系把舍入损失由 4/3 降至 12/11，得 60/11+ε。误差项 8mτ+4nη≤ε·OPT_0 成立；接受操作总数 N≤nKη/τ=mK=O(mn/ε)，故总运行时间多项式。相较先前精确可行的最优结果（6.373+ε，需一致开启费用）有改进，同时去除了开启费用一致性的限制；因子 ≈5.455 接近无异常值 CFL 的已知最优 5+ε。附录给出合并完整证明、参数与运行时间、交换森林构造与证书的多项式搜索过程（open 交换用 0-1 背包 DP，close 交换用分配 DP，整体 O(m³n²)）。文末注明作者借助 GPT-6.1（ultra reasoning）获得热启动改进 60/11+ε 并润色表述。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"配额恢复"与"惩罚分析"解耦：仅改进 CFL 或惩罚目标本身的近似因子并不能自动转移到 CFLO，必须额外建立能保留算法与比较解拒绝数量"带符号差异"的不等式 c(S)+3λ(q−|C_S|) ≤ 5OPT+δ，因为只有在两侧同时出现同一系数 3 时，惩罚项才能在取平均时精确消去。作者指出，若未来 CFL 技术能扩展为提供合适的带符号惩罚比较，CFLO 的保证可随之改进；当前方法距离无异常值 CFL 的 5+ε 仍有一小段差距。此外，Friggstad 等人的结果表明，当容量与离群点预算都必须严格满足时，有界规模的多交换局部搜索可能存在无界的邻域间隙（这是对该邻域的阻碍，而非问题本身不可近似）。

title: Incremental Open Addressing Has No Time-Space Tradeoff
summary: In this paper, we show that there is no time-space tradeoff in incremental open addressing: there is an incremental open-addressed hash table that supports $O(1)$ worst-case expected time insertions, positive queries, and negative queries, at any load factor (even load factor $1$). As an intermediate result, we also revisit the problem of constructing an incremental open-addressed hash table that does not perform reordering (does not move elements around over time). In this setting, we show that it is possible to get $O(1)$ amortized expected positive query time together with $O(1)$ worst-case expected insertion time, a combination that was not previously known to be possible.

AI.tldr: 在增量（仅插入）开放寻址哈希中不存在时间—空间权衡：存在一种增量开放寻址哈希表，除"元素个数计数器"外不存任何元数据，在任意负载因子（包括负载因子为 1 的满表）下，插入、正查询、负查询均可在 O(1) 最坏情况期望时间内完成；同时作为中间结果，还首次实现了"无重排"情形下 O(1) 最坏情况期望插入 + O(1) 摊还期望正查询的组合。
AI.motivation: 开放寻址哈希表的核心问题是负载因子 ε→0 时插入与查询的最优时间权衡。动态场景已由 Bender–Kuszmaul–Zhou (BKZ24, "rainbow hashing") 解决：O(1) 期望查询 + O(log log ε^{-1}) 期望更新，并给出 Ω(log log ε^{-1}) 匹配下界。而增量（insert-only）场景的最优权衡长期未知：BKZ24 的 Ω(log log ε^{-1}) 下界是否仍然成立？此前增量模型的最好结果是 FKK24（elastic hashing）与 FKK26（pretzel probing）：O(1) 摊还期望正查询，但插入需 Ω(log ε^{-1}) 摊还期望时间，根源是"coupon collecting 瓶颈"——每次插入需随机探测找到空槽。而经典重排方案（Robin Hood、cuckoo 系、ordered hashing 等）为了快查询必须付出 Ω(ε^{-1}) 或 Ω(ε^{-2}) 的插入代价。因此需要回答：增量模型中插入慢是本质的吗？本文的目标是给出增量开放寻址的最优构造。
AI.method:
**数据布局**：把 n 个槽位逻辑组织成一片完美二叉树森林 T_1,…,T_α（α=log₂n−1），树大小几何递减（|T_{i+1}| ≥ |T_i|/4，Σ_{r>i}|T_r| ≤ 3|T_i|，见式 (16)）；每个节点占 2 个槽（根占 4 个）以保证 |T_i| 为 2 的幂；叶子为第 1 层。
**关键不变式**：只有当节点的全部后代子树都已满时该节点才可存元素——于是"子树是否满"等价于"根节点是否满"，可用 O(1) 次槽读完成满性测试，从而一次插入可"一次性收集超常数张优惠券"，突破 coupon-collecting 瓶颈。
**哈希**：每个元素 x 用独立随机哈希 L_i 为每棵树选一个候选叶 L_i(x)，并取随机优先级 g_i(x)∈[0,1]。
**Epoch/Phase 调度**：第 i 个 epoch 负责把 T_i 填到 (1−η) 比例，同时"清理"（cleanup）上一棵树 T_{i−1} 至全满；epoch 再分为 phase 1..h+1，非末 phase j 占本 epoch Θ(1/j²) 比例的插入，末 phase 确定性保证清空完成（Lemma 2.1、2.2）。
**插入**：先做 cleanup attempt（对 T_{i−1} 中 x 的 level-j home subtree 调用 TryInsertSubtree，要求 g_{i−1}(x)<1/j⁴），失败则做 current-array insertion（沿 T_i 中 x 的 home path 自底向上尝试，命中非满孩子即放入）。
**概率分析**：用 balls-into-bins + Chernoff 界与负关联引理 (Lemma 2.5)，通过"bad subtree"递归（用半高子树而非孩子做比较以避免概率不衰减）证明 P(bad) ≤ e^{−2^{j/5}}（Lemma 2.6–2.8），进而证明绝大多数 level-j 子树在 phase j 结束时已满（Lemma 2.7），并证明溢出会留下"拥挤"证据（Lemma 2.9–2.10），得到插入期望 O(1)（Lemma 2.11）与元素期望搜索界 E[q(u)]=O(s)（s 为其所在 epoch，Lemma 2.12），配合 epoch 长度几何衰减得 Σq_t = O(n)（Lemma 2.13）。
**查询序列（oblivious）**：每棵树有一个 local list，交错"ancestor list"（home leaf 到根的路径）与"expanding-subtree list"（逐级 home 子树），按树大小合并为全局固定探测序列，满足"T_i 的第 k 次 local probe 出现在全局前 16ik² 次探测内"（式 (3)）。
**升级为最坏情况期望正查询（Sec 3）**：epoch s>2 的插入先把新元素 x 换入 L_1(x) 的首槽，把被挤出的 y 改按 Sec 2 算法重插入，从而把 Θ(s) 的高查询代价随机分摊给既有元素；P(某元素在 epoch s 被逐出)=O((3/4)^s)，累加得期望查询 O(1)（Lemma 3.1、Thm 1.3）。
**负查询（Sec 4）**：引入"breadcrumb"隐式编码——(a) 把优先级异常低（g<1/j⁴）的元素放到 T_1 的叶中以编码树索引上界 I(x)；(b) 每个节点用其两个元素的相对顺序编码 1 bit（空/1 元素/2 元素递增序记 0，否则记 1），由此逐层编码 home subtree 下界 K_i(x)；J_i(x)=max{j: g_i(x)<1/j⁴} 只依赖优先级。插入分三步：按 Sec 3 插入、留痕（把祖先位设为 1）、记录逐出（在 level-ℓ 祖先处与低优先级元素 v 交换）。查询按"等待节点"规则计算 I、J、K 并决定何时终止。
**正确性**：Lemma 4.1（不会对非满节点置位）、4.2（I(z)≥s 且 min{I(z),s} 不减）、4.3（全体元素始终 safe）、4.4（查询绝不误报"不存在"）。
**代价分析**：定义"expensive 节点"（4 类触发情形），证明固定 level-ℓ 节点昂贵的概率为 O(2^{−20ℓ})（Lemma 4.5）；插入期望 O(1)；正查询 E[q(x)] ≤ O(1)+Σ O(4^ℓ)O(2^{−20ℓ}) = O(1)；负查询用 E[4^{4K_i}]=O(1)、P(I(x)≥100b)=O(b^{−3}) 及 Hölder 不等式得 E[cost] = O(1)+Σ_{i≥2}O(i^{−2}+i^{−5/4}) = O(1)。
**附录**：A.1 去掉 n 为 2 的幂的假设并给出任意 n 的地址/当前 epoch 与 phase 的常数时间计算（仅靠计数器 c 与移位、popcount）；A.2 给出显式固定探测调度（分层 round 合并各树 local list，保证式 (3) 且只需 O(1) 个字的工作空间，避免在每棵树保存进度）；B 证明动态扩容与删除同难：任何保持负载 1−ε 且 O(1) 查询的"增长型"开放寻址表必须有 Ω(log log ε^{-1}) 摊还期望每次操作。
AI.result:
**定理 1.1（主结果）**：存在允许重排的增量开放寻址哈希表，除"元素个数计数器"外无任何元数据，在所有负载因子（直至 1）下插入、正查询、负查询均为 O(1) 最坏情况期望时间（期望仅取自随机哈希函数）；即使第 n 次插入（填满最后一个空槽）或表 100% 满时的任意查询也只需 O(1) 期望时间。
**定理 1.2（无重排的"热身"结果）**：存在无重排的增量开放寻址哈希表，在所有负载因子（直至 1）下插入 O(1) 最坏情况期望、正查询 O(1) 摊还期望；同时最坏情况期望正查询为 O(log n)，达到无重排情形的已知下界 Ω(log n)。这是首次同时实现"无重排 + O(1) 最坏情况期望插入 + O(1) 摊还期望正查询"，从而消除了 FKK24/FKK26 的 coupon-collecting 插入瓶颈（此前二者插入需 Ω(log ε^{-1})）。
**定理 1.3**：允许重排时，插入与正查询均达 O(1) 最坏情况期望（仅用随机逐出技巧即可由 1.2 升级得到）。
**附录 B（负面结果）**：增量构造的 O(1) 性质不能延伸到动态扩容——任何随时间增长、维持负载因子 1−ε 且查询 O(1) 的开放寻址表，每次操作必须付出 Ω(log log ε^{-1}) 摊还期望时间，与 BKZ24 的动态界一致。
**技术要点**：与 partner hashing（BKZ25，非 oblivious）中"元素被换出其 home 后必须自适应跳转"不同，本文的换出/交换严格发生在元素自身固定探测序列的邻近位置，解码出的信息只用于决定"何时停止探测"而非"探测哪个槽"，因此仍是经典（oblivious）模型下的解。
**与 AI 工具**：论文末尾声明主要技术贡献由作者完成，AI 工具（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT 6 Astra、Gemini 4 Argon）仅用于结构组织、初稿与文字润色，附录 B 的下界证明由 AI 在作者指导下产出并经作者独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 增量开放寻址的最优权衡被完全解决：**不存在时间—空间（时间—负载因子）权衡**——在固定容量的增量模型下，插入与正/负查询可同时做到 O(1) 最坏情况期望时间，且不需要任何辅助元数据（除元素计数）与任何自适应（非 oblivious）探测。这与动态模型形成鲜明分离：动态场景中 Ω(log log ε^{-1}) 的更新代价是本质的（且该下界同样适用于"只增长不删除"的动态扩容，附录 B）。因此真正的分界线不是"是否重排"，而是"增量 vs 动态（删除/扩容）"。技术上，论文展示了三个可迁移的范式：(1) 用"节点满 ⇔ 子树满"的不变式把满性检测降到 O(1)，从而绕开 coupon-collecting 瓶颈；(2) 用随机逐出/交换把"插入时机造成的查询代价不均衡"随机化，从而把摊还界升级为最坏情况期望界；(3) 用元素排列本身隐式编码结构元数据（1 bit/节点 + 低优先级元素充当面包屑），在 oblivious 模型中实现可提前终止的负查询——这是隐式数据结构思想在开放寻址中的新应用。后续开放问题包括：去除对随机哈希函数的依赖、实现确定性强保证或高概率保证版本、以及在更一般模型（如键值对、带删除的摊还界）下的推广。

title: Online Metric Matching with Unknown i.i.d. Arrivals
summary: We study online metric matching with $n$ servers and $n$ requests drawn independently from an unknown distribution. Each request must be matched immediately and irrevocably to an unused server, and the algorithm receives no samples before the process starts. We give a randomized algorithm that is $O((\log\log\log n)^2)$-competitive on arbitrary metric spaces and $O(1)$-competitive on tree metrics. These guarantees match the corresponding bounds for known i.i.d. request distributions in [GGPW19] up to constant factors. More generally, our competitive ratio is $O(\alpha(n))$ whenever the Fair-Bias algorithm introduced in that work has competitive ratio $\alpha(n)$ for known i.i.d. arrivals on the same class of metrics. Consequently, proving that Fair-Bias is constant-competitive on general metrics would also yield a constant-competitive algorithm for unknown i.i.d. arrivals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线度量匹配中的"未知 i.i.d."到达模型：n 个服务器、n 个独立同分布请求，分布 D 事先不可知，算法只能看到已到达的请求。作者给出一个随机算法：一般度量空间竞争比 O((log log log n)^2)，树度量空间为 O(1)（有限支撑时 25，任意支撑时 51）。更一般地，只要已知 i.i.d. 模型下的 Fair-Bias 算法在某类度量上竞争比为 α(n)，本文算法即为 O(α(n)) 竞争。因此该结果把"已知 i.i.d."的上界迁移到了"未知 i.i.d."模型，并与随机顺序模型（最优 Θ(log n)）形成分离，说明未知 i.i.d. 模型在竞争比意义上更接近已知 i.i.d. 模型。
AI.motivation: 在线度量匹配中，请求到达模型决定了难度：对抗式到达下随机算法最坏需 O(log²n)，已知 i.i.d. 到达下已有 O((log log log n)²)（一般度量）与 O(1)（树度量）的结果，而随机顺序模型的最优竞争比为 Θ(log n)。三种模型存在难度层级：已知 i.i.d. ≤ 未知 i.i.d. ≤ 随机顺序。核心问题是：未知 i.i.d. 模型（分布不可知、无预样本）在竞争比数量级上究竟更接近已知 i.i.d. 还是随机顺序？此前仅在直线度量上对未知 i.i.d. 有 O(1) 结果，一般度量与树度量尚无答案。已有的已知 i.i.d. 求解法（Harada–Gollakota–Penskaja–Wu 的 Fair-Bias，arXiv:1904.09284）依赖从已知分布 D 到服务器经验分布 ν 的最优传输计划，故无法直接用于分布未知的场景；本文要解决的核心技术障碍正是在完全无分布信息下生成"合法"的虚拟请求并控制其转换代价。
AI.method:
设定：度量空间 (X,d)，服务器位置 s_1..s_n 已知且带标签，请求 r_1..r_n i.i.d. 来自未知 D，保证为期望比 E[ALG] ≤ c·E[OPT]（非 E[ALG/OPT]）。

算法（Algorithm 1，Algorithm 1 伪码）：维护自由服务器集合 F。每步 t 观察到 r_t 后，形成经验分布 D̂_t = (1/t)Σδ_{r_i}，计算从 D̂_t 到 ν（服务器标签均匀分布）的一个固定的最优传输计划 π_t（行=请求，列=服务器标签，行和 1/t，列和 1/n，用固定打破平局规则）；按 P(J_t=j | r_1..r_t) = t·π_t(t,j) 抽取"虚拟标签" J_t，令虚拟请求 r'_t = s_{J_t}；将 J_t 交给 Fair-Bias（其计划 ρ_F 从 ν 到剩余标签均匀分布 ν_F 的最优传输，按 n·ρ_F(J_t,i) 选出服务器 a_t），把真实请求 r_t 指派给 a_t。虚拟标签可能指向已被占用的服务器。

关键技术引理：
- Lemma 2.1：n·W_1(D̂_n, ν) = OPT(R,S)（运输计划与完美匹配等价，由双随机矩阵的凸分解得到）。
- Lemma 3.1（对应 GG-PW 的 Lemma 2.2）：在独立均匀标签输入下，Fair-Bias 前 t 步使用的服务器集合 A_t ∼ U_t，且 E[L_t] = Σ_{k=n-t+1}^n g_k；其中 g_k = E_{A∼U_k}[W_1(ν_A, ν)]。
- Lemma 4.1：k·W_1(ν_A,ν) = (n−k)·W_1(ν_{A^c},ν)，故 k g_k = (n−k) g_{n−k}。
- Lemma 4.2：f_t ≤ g_t + (1/t)Σ_{k=n−t+1}^n g_k（用三角不等式把前 t 条匹配边看作从 ν̂_t 到 ν_{A_t} 的运输计划，无需独立性）。
- Theorem 4.3：Σ_{t=1}^n f_t ≤ 2 Σ_{k=1}^n g_k（关键换序求和 + Lemma 4.1 的对称化）。
- Lemma 5.1（独立性）：对任意固定请求多重集 M，若按均匀随机顺序呈现并按上述规则抽取虚拟标签，则 P(J_1=j_1,…,J_t=j_t) = n^{-t}；故对 i.i.d. 真实请求，J_1..J_n 独立且均匀，虚拟请求是 ν 的 i.i.d. 样本（归纳证明 + 计划的目的地约束）。
- Lemma 5.2（转换代价）：E[d(r_t, r'_t)] = E[W_1(D̂_t, ν)]（对"哪个请求是最后一个"取 1/t 均匀权重求和）。
- Lemma 6.1：n·W_1(D,ν) ≤ E[OPT]；E[W_1(D̂_t,ν)] ≤ W_1(D,ν) + f_t；E[OPT_ν] ≤ E[OPT] + n·W_1(D,ν) ≤ 2E[OPT]（用从 D 到 ν 的最优传输耦合 i.i.d. 请求与 ν 样本，并用同一匹配）。
- Theorem 6.2（主定理）：若 Fair-Bias 在该类度量上竞争比为 α(n)，则本算法 E[ALG] ≤ (1+6α(n))·E[OPT]，由 E[ALG] ≤ nW_1(D,ν)+Σf_t+Σg_k ≤ E[OPT]+6α(n)E[OPT] 得出。
- 一般度量到有限度量的归约：把每个请求移至最近服务器位置（可用或不可用均可），把 β-竞争变为 (2β+1)-竞争。
- 与随机顺序的比较：Lemma 5.1 对随机顺序仍成立，但 (6.3) 的类比式失效——例：两服务器 {0,1}，随机顺序请求多重集 M={0,1}，OPT(M,S)=0，而 ν 的两个独立请求重合概率 1/2，故 E[OPT_ν]=1/2 > 0，故交换性本身不蕴含该比较。
AI.result: 1) 一般度量空间：随机在线算法对任意未知 i.i.d. 分布 D 与任意服务器摆位，满足 E[ALG] ≤ O((log log log n)²)·E[OPT]（常数因子来自 1+6α(n)，α(n)=O((log log log n)²) 取自 GG-PW 的已知 i.i.d. 结果），与已知 i.i.d. 模型上界同阶（至常数倍）。2) 树度量：Fair-Bias 的 α(n)=4 代入得有限支撑分布下 25-竞争、任意支撑下 51-竞争，即 O(1)。3) 一般化归约：本文算法竞争比为 O(α(n))，α(n) 为 Fair-Bias 在同一度量类上已知 i.i.d. 到达的竞争比；若能证明 Fair-Bias 在一般度量上为 O(1)，则未知 i.i.d. 也有 O(1) 算法。4) 与随机顺序模型分离：本文上界 o(log n)，远小于随机顺序模型的最优 Θ(log n) 下界，说明未知 i.i.d. 在竞争比数量级上更接近已知 i.i.d.。5) 注意：本文结果不蕴含两模型的最优竞争比同阶——若存在非 Fair-Bias 的 O(1) 已知 i.i.d. 算法而 Fair-Bias 为 ω(1)，两模型仍可能分离。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出把已知 i.i.d. 上界"免费"迁移到未知 i.i.d. 到达模型的通用机制：用经验分布到服务器均匀分布的最优传输计划生成虚拟请求，虚拟标签序列被证明是独立均匀的（Lemma 5.1），而转换代价可由累计运输成本的不等式 Σf_t ≤ 2Σg_k 控制；由此得到一般度量 O((log log log n)²)、树度量 O(1) 的竞争比，且最终竞争比形式为 O(Fair-Bias 的竞争比)。方法论上的启示是：生成"合法"的独立虚拟输入本身并不构成竞争比保证，转换代价还必须能被计入一个恰当的离线基准（Lemma 6.1 的 E[OPT_ν] ≤ 2E[OPT] 在随机顺序模型下失效，是两种模型分离的根本原因）。遗留的开放问题：证明 Fair-Bias 在一般度量上是常数竞争（则未知 i.i.d. 也为常数竞争），以及判定已知 i.i.d. 与未知 i.i.d. 两模型最优竞争比是否真正同阶。附带说明：论文末尾披露作者使用 AI 工具辅助润色文本与统一记号、讨论证明，作者对最终内容负责。

title: Testing Implies Distance Estimation with Polynomial Loss
summary: A tester decides whether a graph has a property or is far from having it. A distance estimator asks for more: it must approximately determine how many edges need to be changed. A property is said to be testable if there is a tester with a number of queries bounded independently of the graph's order for each conceivable distance. Similarly, if a property admits an estimator with a number of queries bounded independently of the graph's order, it is said to be estimable. Fischer and Newman proved that, in the dense graph model, every testable property is also estimable. We show that the passage from testing to estimation requires only a polynomial increase in query complexity. This resolves a long-standing open problem in property testing, previously tackled by Fiat and Ron, by Hoppen, Kohayakawa, Lang, Lefmann, and Stagni, and by Gishboliner, Kushnir, and Shapira.

AI.tldr: 论文证明在稠密图模型中，任何可测试（testable）的图性质都可被转换为距离估计器（distance estimator），且查询复杂度仅增加多项式因子（poly(max{1, q(cε)}, 1/ε)，c = 1/100），从而解决了由 Fischer–Newman 提出、被 Fiat–Ron、Hoppen 等、Gishboliner–Kushnir–Shapira 推进的长期公开问题：先前最佳结果需双指数/单指数损失，而本工作只需多项式损失。
AI.motivation: 稠密图（邻接矩阵）模型的性质测试中，ε-tester 只需区分"属于性质"与"距离性质至少 ε"，而 ε-estimator 需要在所有输入上近似 dist(G, P)。Fischer 与 Newman 证明稠密模型中可测性蕴含可估性，但其证明依赖 Szemerédi 正则性引理，查询复杂度损失为塔型（tower-type）。随后 Hoppen–Kohayakawa–Lang–Lefmann–Stagni、Fiat–Ron 给出双指数界，Gishboliner–Kushnir–Shapira 改进到单指数界。核心问题是：测试到估计的转换是否只需多项式损失？此前所有方法都借助"正则划分 + 密度参数搜索"路线，其划分规模导致指数/塔型损失，因此需要一条绕开强正则性、只用弱正则性/能量增量的新路线。
AI.method:
证明分三步，核心是把"修复图"的最优化变成可采样的稠密 CSP。
(1) 惩罚化目标：先放大 tester 置信度并用 Goldreich–Trevisan 规范化定理把 tester 化为采样 s = O(max{1,q(τ)}·log(1/τ)) 个顶点、对称规则 f: G_s → [0,1] 的 canonical tester（τ = ε/100）。定义 rej(J) = E_v f(J[v])，并令 M(G) = min_J {d(G,J) + 2·rej(J)}。由三角不等式与"τ-远图罚分 ≥ 4/3 > 1 ≥ 距离"得 dist(G,P) − τ ≤ M(G) ≤ dist(G,P) + 2τ。目标函数多线性，故把边放宽为 [0,1] 权重并独立取整后最小值不变（Fact 1、Lemma 1）。
(2) 计数引理与短描述近似：编辑代价 cost_G(W) = ⟨G,1⟩ + ⟨W, 1−2G⟩，故成本只需一个测试 1−2G；为控制拒绝概率，构造 tester 在某条采样边上的离散导数 ∂_b f(x,y) = f(F_1(b,x,y)) − f(F_0(b,x,y))（锚点图 b 与两端点邻接向量），并把两种角色平均成对称核 κ_b，得一族取值于 [−1,1] 的成对测试 T。逐边插值证明计数引理 |E_G(W) − E_G(Z)| ≤ (1+4K)‖W−Z‖_T（K = binom(s,2)）。
(3) Boosting + 标签化 + CSP 采样：用势函数 Φ_H(Q) = E_e[ψ(Q(e)) − Q(e)H(e) + H(e)²/2]（ψ' = clip，1-Lipschitz），沿测试方向做能量增量式修正，得 t < γ^{-2} 次更新、W = clip(G + γΣB_j) 且 ‖H−W‖_T ≤ γ；把该修正序列编码为每顶点标签（长度 O(s²γ^{-2})），解码器 D(G(uv), z_u, z_v) 恢复加权图，得 M(G) ≤ M̃(G) ≤ M(G) + (1+4K)γ，log|Λ| = O(s⁶ε^{−2})。随后把最小化 E_G(W_z) 写成稠密 s 元 CSP（每条 s 元组贡献 [0,1] 谓词，OPT(I(G)) = a_n(1 − M̃(G)/3)），用 Bernasconi–Castiglioni–Celli–Farina–Malavolta 的 subsampling 定理以 m = O(k^{12}θ^{−6}log²(Q0k²/θ)) 大小的样本逼近最优，多样本平均 + Chebyshev 得到 2/3 成功概率，最终输出 clip(3(1 − V̄/a_n))。
AI.result: 主定理（Theorem 2）：存在绝对常数 c > 0（可取 c = 1/100），若性质 P 具有查询复杂度 q(ε) 的 ε-tester，则 P 具有 ε-estimator，其边查询复杂度为 poly(max{1, q(cε)}, 1/ε)；特别地，poly(1/ε) 可测当且仅当 poly(1/ε) 可估。定理适用于一般图性质，允许原 tester 自适应且有双边错误。推论（Corollary 1）：对 natural 性质或非平凡 hereditary 性质，因 q(ε) = Ω(1/ε)，界可简化为 poly(q(cε))。此外文中给出若干独立结论：多线性目标在加权图上的最小值等于无权图上的最小值；计数引理 |rej(W) − rej(Z)| ≤ 2K‖W−Z‖_T；boosting 步数 t < γ^{−2} 与 n 无关。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了稠密图模型中"测试蕴含估计"这一长期公开问题，把此前最好的单指数损失降为多项式损失。方法学要点是：不使用正则性划分来描述候选修复，而是（i）用 tester 诱导的导数测试族构成计数引理所需的"测试集"，（ii）用 Frieze–Kannan 式的能量增量/boosting 得到短标签描述，（iii）把剩余的最优化化为稠密 CSP 并借助采样定理求解。该框架与 regularity 路线解耦，说明当直接论证可用时塔型损失可以避免；同时也表明短描述（标签长度关于 s 与 1/ε 为多项式）配合对数依赖标签数的稠密 CSP 采样是估计类问题的通用工具。

title: Metric TSP in Sublinear Time: Breaking Two Approximation
summary: The seminal result of Czumaj and Sohler [STOC'04] showed that a 2-approximation of the value of metric TSP can be obtained with sublinear queries. Whether sublinear algorithms can break the 2-approximation barrier has remained a major open problem. See problem 71 on this http URL . This paper resolves this open problem. We show there are fixed $\varepsilon, \delta > 0$ such that a $(2-\delta)$-approximation of metric TSP value can be obtained with $O(n^{2-\varepsilon})$ queries. Here $n$ is the number of vertices, and the input size is $\Theta(n^2)$.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了 sublinear.info 上的开放问题 71：在距离查询（entry query）模型下，仅需 Õ(n^{2−ε}) 次查询即可对任意 n 点度量的最优哈密顿回路长度给出 (2−δ) 近似（ε, δ 为与 n 无关的绝对常数），从而突破了 Czumaj 与 Sohler (STOC'04) 建立的 2-近似次线性屏障，且算法运行时间亦为 O(n^{2−γ})。
AI.motivation: Czumaj 与 Sohler [STOC'04] 证明了度量 TSP 的最优值可用次线性次查询获得 2-近似（经由 MST 权重估计，因 M ≤ TSP ≤ 2M），但"次线性查询能否突破 2-近似"作为二十余年未解的核心开放问题（sublinear.info 问题 71）悬而未决。障碍在于：仅凭 MST 权重无法区分 TSP ≈ 2M（路径度量）与 TSP ≈ M（环度量）这两类可由完全相同的 MST 复现的度量；且 [9] 只估计 MST 权重而不返回其边，因为求任意常数近似 MST 的边本身需要 Ω(n²) 查询。已有进展局限于特殊度量（(1,2)-度量、图度量）或附加假设（整数权重、MST 全部由权重 1 边组成、或免费给出 MST），在无限制的一般度量下仍无法突破 2。此外，Chen–Kannan–Khanna 证明 (1+δ) 近似在 (1,2)-度量与图度量中已需 Ω(n²) 查询，说明"任意好近似"不可行，但常数级突破（略小于 2）在理论上仍是开放的方向。
AI.method: 核心是把"改进 TSP 的 2-近似"归约为"判定 Cut LP 最优值 K 是接近 M 还是接近 M/2"。作者给出两个关键不等式 M/2 ≤ K ≤ M 与 max(M,2K) ≤ TSP ≤ M+K（后者经由 O-join 多重图取欧拉回路并用三角不等式 shortcut）。分析层面：Cut LP 的对偶等价于"被度量支配（dominated）的加权 Steiner 树"（Claim 4.1、Lemma 4.2 用 uncrossing 得到 laminar 支撑的 Steiner 表示）；并证明当 D = M−K 小时存在被支配的 MST 缩短（shortening）T₀ 满足 w(T₀) ≥ K−D（Lemma 4.3），且 w(T⟨S⟩)−2D ≤ K(S) ≤ w(T⟨S⟩)（Lemma 4.4）。算法层面分四步：(1) 基础终端集 S_base = S_root ∪ S_split 由采样 S₀、候选边过滤、高度点集 H₁ 与分裂样本构造，把 MST 切成大小 Õ(n^{a₀}) 的片段（fragment），并可对任意顶点用 Õ(n^{1+5a₀}) 次查询恢复其片段；(2) 逐级加更细的 r-网（N，r = M̂n^{−1+a/10}）扩充核心终端集 S（|S| = Õ(n^{1−a})），若 K(S) 已超阈值则提前返回；随后在 S 的诱导度量上求最优被支配 Steiner 树 C（"计算核心"，用 Chekuri–Quanrud 乘性权重算法求 Cut LP 并由对偶载荷 ρ(u,v) 恢复 Steiner 树），并由终端距离构造非扩张映射 q: V → R(C)（Lemma 5.3，基于树上子树的 Helly 性质 Lemma 3.1）；(3) 核心分解为单元：围绕 essential 顶点的 buffer cell 与随机相移的 interval cell，regular cell（|V_P| < n^a）通过 O(|V_P|²) 查询显式求最优局部 Steiner 树 K_P，contracted cell 则用 cell fragment 的最优缩短、离散化尺度 σ = εM̂/(100n) 构造冲突图，并以最小分数点覆盖 τ_P 得到局部解 A_P − τ_P；(4) 估计：L = w(F_dual) = Σ_regular K_P + Σ_contracted (A_P − τ_P)，用重要性采样估计 A，用冲突图二分双覆盖上的 peeling（降低最大度至 Õ(n^{1/3})）+ Behnezhad 的次线性 RGMM 匹配估计器估计 τ。分析给出 E[L] ≥ K − c₁D − c₂εM̂。
AI.result: 主定理：存在绝对常数 ε, δ > 0 与随机算法，用 O(n^{2−ε}) 次距离查询、以至少 2/3 的概率返回估计值满足 TSP ≤ TSP̂ ≤ (2−δ)·TSP；算法运行时间为 O(n^{2−γ})（γ > 0 为绝对常数），仅使用距离查询，不假设给定 MST、也不限制度量类别。具体地，若 L̂ ≥ (1+ε)M̂/2 则返回 2M̂（此时由 TSP ≥ 2K ≥ 2L̂ 得比值严格小于 2），否则返回 (2−ε)M̂（此时 D > εM，故 TSP ≤ M+K = 2M−D ≤ (2−ε)M），两分支均保证 TSP ≤ TSP̂ ≤ (2−ε/2)·TSP。
AI.conclusion: 本文在完全一般度量、无需 MST 的条件下首次实现次线性查询下的严格优于 2 的 TSP 值近似，了结了 longstanding 的开放问题。其技术范式是"Cut LP 对偶 + 被支配 Steiner 树 + MST 缩短"作为分析工具，配合"核心—单元分解 + 冲突图最小分数点覆盖 + 次线性采样/匹配估计"作为算法实现，关键在于通过单元化与重要性采样把全局 MST 结构信息替换为可局部探索的信息。局限与遗留问题包括：ε, δ 均为未具体化的绝对常数（未给出显式数值），算法为随机且需要 2/3 成功概率保证；同时该框架仅给出值估计（并非构造近似哈密顿回路），且最优近似比与查询复杂度之间的权衡（能否达到如 1.9 或 Õ(n) 查询）仍未解决；论文亦披露使用了 LLM 辅助构思部分算法思路。

title: State Evolution and Universality of Iterated Linear Programs for the Binary Perceptron
summary: The binary perceptron is a random constraint satisfaction problem that asks for a sign vector satisfying a system of random linear inequalities. Its solution space has a strikingly extreme geometry: at every positive constraint density, all but a vanishing fraction of the solutions are isolated. Yet polynomial-time algorithms find solutions at small enough constraint density, which raises the question of how efficient algorithms navigate such a landscape. Linear programming is a natural algorithm to study here, but its analysis has so far been limited to a single round. Li, Schramm, and Zhou (STOC 2025) analyzed one linear program followed by iterative rounding. In this work, we overcome this limitation and give a precise analysis of iterated linear programming for the binary perceptron. (1) For Gaussian matrices and any fixed number of rounds, we characterize the iterated linear programs exactly through a deterministic state-evolution recursion. (2) Adding a final rounding step, we obtain a randomized polynomial-time algorithm for the binary perceptron. Numerical evaluations of the recursion provide evidence that it succeeds at constraint density $\alpha=0.60$ with zero margin, well beyond the range $\alpha\le0.1$ guaranteed by the single-LP analysis and $\alpha\approx0.327$ (Jo and Lee, 2026), the best guarantee so far. (3) We establish universality, showing that the same characterization holds for matrices with i.i.d. entries drawn from any centered, unit-variance subgaussian law. The key idea of our proof is that, although conditioning on earlier rounds makes the matrix non-Gaussian, its conditional law can be computed explicitly and remains close to a Gaussian law, so the convex Gaussian min-max theorem applies in every round. For universality, we compare Gaussian and subgaussian matrices through the Lindeberg principle, using a regularized version of each linear program.

AI.tldr: 本文对二元感知机（binary perceptron）的“迭代线性规划”（Iterated-LP）给出首个精确分析：对高斯矩阵与任意固定轮数，用确定性状态演化（state evolution）递推精确刻画每轮冻结坐标比例、坐标轨迹分布与约束裕度分布；借助该递推加上 Lovett–Meka 舍入阶段构造随机多项式时间算法，数值证据显示其在零裕度、约束密度 α=0.60 时成功，远超单轮 LP 的 α≤0.1 与在线算法的 0.327；并通过 Lindeberg 原理与正则化代理二次规划证明对任意中心化、单位方差、次高斯分布同样成立。
AI.motivation: 二元感知机是典型的随机约束满足问题：给定随机矩阵 A∈R^{M×N}，寻找符号向量 σ∈{±1}^N 满足 Aσ≥κ1。它的解空间几何极为极端——在任意正的约束密度 α=M/N 下，除可忽略比例外所有解都是孤立的（ shattering），但多项式时间算法在较小 α 下仍能找到解，形成“解几乎都被冻结却有高效算法”的张力。已有算法保证都很弱：在线算法阈值约 0.327–0.367（Jo & Lee 2026），Lipschitz 类算法（梯度下降、Langevin动力学、AMP）的阈值由随机控制刻画，消息传递启发式在 ~0.74 有效，而解的存在容量约 0.833。LP 属于这两类之外的算法：它读取整个矩阵再定符号（非在线），且最优解是多面体顶点、随矩阵微扰会跳变（非 Lipschitz）。Li、Schramm、Zhou（STOC 2025, LSZ25）分析了一个 LP 加迭代舍入，只覆盖第一轮：一旦揭示最优解，剩余约束由同一矩阵选出，对该历史条件化后矩阵不再高斯，高斯比较法失效，故他们转向 Lovett–Meka 随机游走，只能保证零裕度 α≤0.1。本文要回答的核心问题是：线性规划自身被迭代时如何行为？
AI.method:
算法（Algorithm 1, Iterated-LP）：固定 K 轮，margin 计划 κ_1>⋯>κ_K>κ；每轮抽独立高斯目标 v_t，在自由坐标上解 max v_t^T x s.t. Ax≥κ_t1、x∈[-1,1]^N、已冻结坐标固定；把达到 ±1 的坐标冻结。核心分析技术：
(1) 历史条件化的处理（Sec.5）：记录完整历史（各轮 x^(r)、λ^(r)、Ax^(r)、A^Tλ^(r)、活跃行集 I_r、自由/冻结集），定义 regular history；用 coarea 公式证明条件律 P_h 与仅按仿射条件的高斯律 Q_h 的 Radon–Nikodym 导数为 ∏_{r≤p}|det A_{I_r,F_r}|^2（KKT 方程的 Jacobian）；由行列式矩估计与相对熵递推 D_r≤2D_{r-1}+C_K log N，配合 Talagrand 运输不等式，在高概率历史集合上把条件矩阵与高斯矩阵耦合并使算子范数差 →0，从而使每轮都能再次使用凸高斯 min–max 比较（Gordon/TOH14）及其优化子局部化推论。

title: Gaussian Difference Dynamics: Breaking the $2^{n/2}$ Barrier for the Shortest Vector Problem and Discrete Gaussian Sampling
summary: We give classical randomized algorithms in a word RAM model that break the $2^{n/2}$ barrier for both discrete Gaussian sampling (DGS) and the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP). For every fixed $\alpha>1$, shifted DGS on arbitrary lattices at width $\sigma\ge\alpha\eta_{1/2}(L)$ takes $$ (3/2)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad (4/3)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ These bounds match the Becker--Ducas--Gama--Laarhoven (BDGL) heuristic sieving exponents. At widths at least $3\eta_{1/2}(L)/2$, the same total cost suffices for an entire batch of $\lfloor(4/3)^{n/2}\rfloor$ samples jointly close to independent target Gaussians. For SVP on arbitrary lattices, our algorithm returns a shortest nonzero vector with high probability in $$ 2^{0.4130n+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad 2^{0.3138n+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ As a corollary, we obtain centered DGS at every width with the same exponents, answering a question of Stephens-Davidowitz (SODA 2016). We introduce Gaussian difference dynamics (GDD), a framework for tracking expected counts and pairwise clustering of vectors through repeated differencing. A closed recursion for the first two counting moments controls these quantities relative to a Gaussian reference, without requiring independence within intermediate lists. Accurate moment bounds let us extract a Gaussian sample by weighted selection, while the weaker bounds needed to establish a shortest vector representation allow us to retain more differences. We perform these transitions on thin spherical shells, where the Gaussian rejection weights can be renormalized at subexponential cost. For batch sampling, we combine this geometry with the double rejection technique of Doulgerakis and Laarhoven to control the joint distribution of outputs while reusing vectors.

title: XOR-Functions and Beyond in the Random Query Model
summary: We study time--space tradeoffs for computing Boolean functions $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ in the random query model. On input $x$, a branching program receives independent samples $(i,x(i))$, where $i$ is uniform in $[n]$. We want to evaluate $f(x)$ while minimizing the width $2^S$ and the length $T$ of the branching program. There is a simple upper bound of $T = \tilde{O}(n)$, $S = O(n)$: coupon-collector shows that $\tilde{O}(n)$ samples suffice, and they can be stored in $O(n)$ space. Raz and Zhan (ITCS 2020) introduced this model and studied the zero-error setting. In the bounded-error setting, Dinur (SODA 2024) proved $TS = \tilde{\Omega}(n \cdot inf[f])$, where $inf[f]$ is the total influence of $f$. For many functions with low influence such as Equality and Tribes, this lower bound can leave a substantial gap from the best known upper bounds. Our main result is a stronger lower bound of $T(S+\log T) = \Omega(n \cdot sens[g])$ for any XOR-function $g(x,y)= f(x \oplus y)$, where $sens[g]$ is the sensitivity of $g$. Through simple corollaries, we get tight nearly-quadratic time--space lower bounds for Tribes and Equality, despite their low influence. Our proof introduces a new notion of information complexity tailored to the random query model along with a corresponding direct-sum argument which may be of independent interest. Dinur also proved a tight bound of $TS = \Omega(n^2)$ for Majority, whose influence is only $\Theta(\sqrt{n})$, and asked whether an alternative characterization of Boolean functions could give a unified proof of tight results for a broader class of functions, including Majority. We answer this open question by proving $TS = \tilde{\Omega}(n \cdot dgn[f])$, where $dgn[f]$ is the degeneracy of the sensitivity graph of $f$ (for Majority, this is $\Theta(n)$). We also prove that this bound is tight for all symmetric functions up to logarithmic factors.

title: Space-Optimal Algorithms for Spanning Forests in Dynamic Streams at Every Confidence Level: With and Without Deletion Constraints
summary: We characterize the optimal space for one-pass spanning-forest computation in dynamic streams of $v$-vertex simple graphs with failure probability at most $\delta$. Nelson and Yu proved an $\Omega(v\log^2v\log(v/\delta))$-bit lower bound, establishing the AGM algorithm's optimality for each fixed $0<\epsilon<1$ and $2^{-v^{1-\epsilon}}<\delta\le1/4$. We resolve the remaining high-confidence regime: for every $0<\delta\le1/4$, matching lower bounds and an algorithm give \[ \Theta\!\left(\min\left\{v^2,\;v\log(v/\delta)\log^2\!\left(2+\frac{v}{\log(v/\delta)}\right)\right\}\right) \] bits, improving space by up to a factor of $\Theta((\log v/\log\log v)^2)$ in this regime. We also study streams with at most $Z$ previously inserted edges deleted and not yet reinserted at report time, where the integer $Z\ge0$ is given in advance. Total deletions, restorations, and intermediate absence counts are unrestricted. For a single report and every $0<\delta\le1/4$, matching lower bounds and a one-pass randomized algorithm yield optimal space $\Theta(\mathcal L(v,Z,\log(1/\delta)))$ bits, where $x_Z(t)=\min\{Z+1,v,\sqrt{vt}\}$ and \[ \mathcal L(v,Z,t)=v\log v\min\{\log^2v,\log^2(Z+2)\} +vt\log\!\left(1+\frac{x_Z(t)}t\right)\log\!\left(1+\frac v{x_Z(t)}\right). \] At zero error, a lower bound for all zero-error algorithms and a matching deterministic algorithm give optimal space \[ \Theta\!\left(\min\{v^2,v(Z+1)\log(1+v/(Z+1))\}\right) \] bits. Together, these results characterize the memory required across all confidence levels and report-time edge-loss bounds.

title: Binary Huffman Coding with Unequal Letter Costs Is NP-Complete
summary: Binary prefix coding assigns prefix-free binary words to symbols to minimize their frequency-weighted cost. Huffman solved the equal-letter-cost case in polynomial time in 1952 [Proc. IRE'52]. For unequal letter costs, Karp gave an integer-programming formulation in 1961 [IRE Trans. Inf. Theory'61]. Exact polynomial-time algorithms for fixed integer costs were given by Golin and Rote [IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory'98] and Bradford, Golin, Larmore, and Rytter [J. Algorithms'02]. For input-dependent costs, Golin, Mathieu, and Young gave a polynomial-time approximation scheme [SICOMP'12]. The exact complexity when letter costs are part of the input had remained unresolved. We resolve this $65$-year-old problem by proving that deciding whether there exists a binary prefix-free code of frequency-weighted cost at most a given threshold is NP-complete, even when the letter costs are consecutive positive integers $(M,M+1)$ supplied as part of the input. All frequencies, letter costs, and thresholds are encoded in binary. Consequently, finding an optimal code is NP-hard. Our proof uses two polynomial-time reductions, starting from Planar Independent Set. The intermediate problem prescribes the number of leaves at each depth of a full ordered binary tree and minimizes a signed linear score on their sorted right-edge counts. The first reduction represents an independent-set verification program by a tree growing level by level. A fixed-profile identity converts narrow coordinate restrictions into linear penalties that enforce the computation. The second reduction adds large dyadic terms to the symbol frequencies to force prescribed depths. These terms contribute a constant to the weighted number of ones, leaving smaller signed perturbations to reproduce the tree score.

title: Dynamic Steiner Tree under Edge Updates
summary: The Steiner tree problem is the canonical generalization of minimum spanning tree (MST). When connectivity is required only among a fixed subset of vertices (terminals), the goal is to maintain a minimum-cost tree connecting these terminals as the graph undergoes edge updates. While dynamic MST has been studied since the 1980s~[Frederickson, STOC'83, SICOMP'85], and the first sublinear-in-$n$ dynamic MST algorithm dates back almost thirty-five years to Eppstein, Galil, Italiano, and Nissenzweig~[FOCS'92, JACM'97], achieving sublinear-in-$n$ update time for dynamic Steiner tree has long remained open, as a single edge update can invalidate many routes in the underlying terminal metric closure. We present the first fully dynamic algorithm for Steiner tree that achieves a constant-factor approximation with sublinear-in-$n$ update time. For any fixed $0<\zeta<1/2$, our deterministic algorithm maintains an $O_\zeta(1)$-approximate Steiner tree for undirected graphs with polynomially bounded edge weights in $\widetilde O(n^{1/2+\zeta})$ amortized update time, answering cost queries in $O(1)$ time, and reporting an explicit tree in $\widetilde O(n^{1+\zeta})$ time. Our approach combines periodic terminal-metric rebuilds on a dynamic spanner with a top-tree dynamic program that localizes edge deletions and reconnects surviving components through a dynamic distance sparsifier. Along the way, we give a simpler randomized insertion-only algorithm with a better, explicit approximation ratio.

title: Distributionally Robust Search: The Power of Information and the Limits of Moments
summary: We study binary search for a target drawn from a distribution on $n$ ordered elements. The cost is the expected number of comparison queries. In our distributionally robust framework, the algorithm knows only an uncertainty set containing the distribution and minimizes its worst-case approximation ratio against an optimal strategy that knows the distribution. Collections of uncertainty sets capture different forms of information: quantiles, moments, general linear measurements, or approximate CDFs. This framework quantifies how much and what form of information is needed for near-optimal search. Our main result separates moments from general linear measurements. Although $n-1$ moments determine the distribution exactly, for every constant $\delta\in(0,1)$, the first $n^{1-\delta}$ exact moments can be as uninformative for search as no information: the worst-case approximation ratio remains $\Omega(\log n)$. In contrast, for every constant $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, $O(n^\varepsilon\log^4 n)$ suitably chosen linear measurements suffice for an $O(1/\varepsilon)$-approximation. The limitation lies in the measurements chosen, rather than linearity itself. title: Glauber Dynamics for Sampling Colorings: Rapid Mixing above $(1+1/\mathrm{e})Δ$ via Hidden Hard-Core Models
summary: We show that for every $\gamma>0$ and every sufficiently large $\Delta$, the Glauber dynamics for proper $q$-colorings of any $n$-vertex graph of maximum degree $\Delta$ has spectral gap $\Omega_\gamma(1/n)$, and hence mixing time $O_\gamma(n^2\log q)$, whenever $q\ge(1+1/\mathrm{e}+\gamma)\Delta$. Our proof establishes a Bochner-type inequality by exploiting the spectral gaps of hard-core models hidden in the color classes. The constant $1+1/\mathrm{e}\approx1.368$ comes from the uniqueness threshold $\approx\mathrm{e}/\Delta$ of the hard-core model on the infinite $\Delta$-regular tree.

title: Pure Differentially Private Query Release via Laplace Input Smoothing
summary: We study the offline release of a public family of $k$ statistical queries on a database of $N$ records from a public universe of size $d$, under pure $\varepsilon$-differential privacy. We give an efficient algorithm that, with probability at least $1-\beta$, answers all queries simultaneously to error $$O\left(\min\left\{1,\sqrt{\frac{\log(d/\beta)\log k}{N\varepsilon}}\right\}\right).$$ The output is a synthetic histogram on the data universe, and its running time depends polynomially on $N,d$ and $k$. This resolves a conjecture of Nikolov and Ullman (2021) with an efficient, polynomial-time construction. Fitzsimons (2026) recently established the same square-root error scale via an information-theoretic construction that relies on a computationally intractable Lipschitz envelope over the exponential space of possible outputs. In contrast, we introduce an input-side smoothing approach: we run a selection-only multiplicative-weights process after a single sparse Laplace perturbation of the input histogram. Departing from standard first-order stability analyses, we investigate the stability of stability by establishing a uniform lower bound on the second-order log-derivatives of the output transcript across $T$ rounds of multiplicative weight updates. We then develop an analytic smoothing principle showing that this curvature bound allows a sparse, coordinate-wise perturbation to guarantee pure differential privacy globally, attaining optimal utility through a conceptually simple, polynomial-time pure-DP mechanism.

title: Tree Covers for Directed Graphs: Distance Oracles, Routing Schemes and Spanners
summary: In a seminal work [STOC'01; JACM'05], Thorup and Zwick showed that every weighted undirected graph admits a tree cover where each vertex belongs to $O(kn^{1/k})$ trees in expectation, and every pair has a path of stretch at most $2k-1$ in some tree. In this paper, we extend this structural property to directed graphs with nonnegative edge weights. Let $\mathrm{dist}_G(u \leftrightarrows v) = \mathrm{dist}_G(u \to v) + \mathrm{dist}_G(v \to u)$ denote the roundtrip distance. For every integer $k$, we construct a collection $\mathcal{T}$ of tree-pairs, each consisting of an in-tree and an out-tree rooted at the same vertex. Each vertex belongs to $O(kn^{1/k})$ tree-pairs in expectation, and for every ordered pair $(u, v)$ some tree-pair $T_{in}\cup T_{out} \in \mathcal{T}$ satisfies $\mathrm{dist}_{T_{in}\cup T_{out}}(u \to v) \le \mathrm{dist}_G(u \to v) + (k-1)\mathrm{dist}_G(u \leftrightarrows v).$ We call this a \emph{$k$-strong (roundtrip) tree cover}. While prior techniques partition distances into geometric scales and build separate structures for each scale, our construction handles all distances simultaneously within a single, unified hierarchy. This yields the first directed tree cover for general $k$ matching the classic Thorup-Zwick stretch-size trade-off. Our cover immediately implies improved constructions of roundtrip spanners, path-reporting distance oracles, and compact routing schemes, as well as their source-wise and prioritized variants. We also provide faster algorithms for these structures: for general $k \ge 4$, all the above objects can be constructed in $\widetilde{O}(\min\{mn, n^{2.5}\})$ expected time, breaking the $mn$ barrier in dense directed graphs.

title: Smallest Multiplicative Stretch for an $α$-APASP Below $\widetilde O \left(n^ω\right)$ Runtime
summary: Dor, Halperin and Zwick [FOCS'96; SICOMP'00] showed that $(2-\varepsilon)$-APASP is at least as hard as BMM for every fixed $0<\varepsilon<1$. Earlier rectangular FMM bounds of Vassilevska Williams, Yinzhan Xu, Zixuan Xu and Zhou [SODA'24] and Alman, Duan, Vassilevska Williams, Yinzhan Xu, Zixuan Xu and Zhou [SODA'25] give $\widetilde O(n^{2.36999465})$ runtime, below the previous $\omega\leq2.371177$ of Dupont, Eisenberger, Kozlovskii, Mehrabian, Ruiz, See, Zhou, Alman, Vassilevska Williams and Balog [arXiv'26]. Current rectangular FMM bounds give $\widetilde O(n^{2.34549151})$, independent of $W_{\max}$. title: Approximation Algorithms for Multi-Criteria Network Design Problems
summary: Min-max multi-criteria optimization asks for a single feasible solution minimizing the maximum of its costs under $\ell$ nonnegative cost functions, a formulation that captures both fairness across groups and robustness across scenarios. It has proved hard to approximate even for basic problems: for robust shortest paths, polylogarithmic approximations are known only in quasi-polynomial time. For network design, the best known guarantee is an $\ell$-approximation, which is tight for the natural LP relaxation. We show that exponentially better and nearly optimal guarantees are achievable for two fundamental network design problems. For multi-criteria connectivity augmentation (MC-CAP), which asks to increase the edge connectivity of a given undirected graph by one, we give a randomized polynomial-time $O(\log \ell)$-approximation algorithm. Applying our augmentation procedure iteratively and analyzing its randomized choices jointly across iterations yields an $O(\log k \log \ell)$-approximation for the multi-criteria $k$-edge-connected spanning subgraph (MC-$k$-ECSS) problem, for every $k \geq 2$. We complement these algorithms with a nearly matching lower bound: for every fixed $\varepsilon > 0$, MC-CAP admits no polynomial-time $O(\log^{1-\varepsilon} \ell)$-approximation, even when the underlying graph is a star, unless $\mathsf{NP}\subseteq\mathsf{DTIME}\bigl(n^{\log^{O(1)}n}\bigr)$. The same hardness extends to the MC-$k$-ECSS problem.

title: Optimal (Randomized) Compact Routing Schemes
summary: Compact routing schemes route messages along short paths while every vertex stores little information. We study the trade-off between the stretch and the storage of compact routing schemes in undirected graphs, in four models: labeled and name-independent schemes, with average or worst-case local storage. We improve the best known stretch in all four models. Our main result is a labeled routing scheme with expected stretch $2k-1$ and $\widetilde O(n^{1/k})$ average local storage, in which only the routing is randomized. Under the Erdős girth conjecture, no scheme with this storage has stretch below $2k-1$, so our scheme is optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors in the storage. With deterministic routing, we obtain stretch $\approx2.47k$, the best known deterministic stretch with average storage. Worst-case local storage is the classical setting of compact routing. The leading coefficient $4$ in the stretch $4k-5$ of Thorup and Zwick~[SPAA'01] was improved only by Chechik~[PODC'13], to $\approx3.68$ in unweighted graphs. In unweighted graphs, we obtain expected stretch $(\frac83k+O(1),O(k))$, and deterministic stretch $\approx3.05k$. Name-independent routing is harder, since the source knows only the name of the destination. The best known stretch with $\widetilde O(n^{1/k})$ local storage in unweighted graphs was $96k$, by Abraham, Gavoille, and Malkhi~[DISC'04]. We improve it by more than a factor of $8$. With average storage, we obtain expected stretch $4k-5$, which matches the labeled scheme of Thorup and Zwick. With worst-case storage in unweighted graphs, we obtain expected stretch $(8k+O(1),O(k))$. All our schemes for unweighted graphs extend to weighted graphs with a small loss in the stretch, and still improve the previous unweighted bounds.

title: Testing for a Large Induced Expander: Sublinear Algorithms and Query Lower Bounds
summary: Testing expansion asks to distinguish graphs of large conductance from graphs that are far from having large conductance. We study a relaxation in which only part of the graph is required to expand: does an $n$-vertex graph of bounded degree contain an induced expander on a constant fraction of its vertices, when the rest of the graph, including the edges leaving the expander, is arbitrary? Let $P_{\alpha,\phi}$ denote the property of containing an induced subgraph on at least $\alpha n$ vertices with inner conductance at least $\phi$. For every constant $\kappa\in(0,1)$, we give a tester that accepts graphs in $P_{\alpha,\phi}$ and rejects graphs outside $P_{\kappa\alpha,\mu\phi^2}$, where $\mu=\Theta_{\alpha,\kappa}(1/\log n)$, using $O_{\alpha,\kappa}(\sqrt n\,\phi^{-2}\log n)$ queries. For fixed $\alpha\in(0,1]$, $\kappa\in(0,1)$, and $0<\phi\le9/20$, we further show that distinguishing these two classes requires $\Omega_{\alpha,\kappa,\phi}(n^{1/2+c_{\kappa,\phi}\mu})$ queries for every sufficiently large $n$ and every $0<\mu\le1$, where $c_{\kappa,\phi}>0$. The bound holds for adaptive algorithms, uniformly in $\mu$. Hence, for testers with $\sqrt n\,\mathrm{polylog}(n)$ queries, the logarithmic loss in conductance is necessary up to a $\log\log n$ factor. The same tester also permits distance-based rejection at a weaker conductance while retaining the original core size. Our tester compares the endpoint distributions of random walks from different vertices with each other, rather than with the uniform distribution. Its analysis uses the trace chain, which observes the walk only at its visits to the unknown expanding core. Our lower bound builds on the noisy-parity construction of [CKK+18], using vector-valued parity labels in $\mathbb F_2^r$ to create many hidden classes, each too small to contain a qualifying induced expander.

title: Differentially Oblivious Priority Queues with Sublogarithmic Cost
summary: In this paper, we study exact online integer priority queues under differential obliviousness in the balls-and-bins model. Given a public upper bound $T$ on the number of operations and assuming that the priorities are bounded by a polynomial in $T$, we construct an $(\eps,\delta)$-differentially oblivious priority queue supporting insertion and minimum extraction, which requires $\polylog(T)$ private memory. For constant $\varepsilon>0$ and $\delta=\exp(-\Theta(\log^2 T))$, our construction incurs $O(\log T/\log\log T)$ expected amortized total work per operation, which breaks the $\Omega(\log T)$ barrier for fully oblivious priority queues~[Jacob et al., SODA'2019]. Further, we prove a matching lower bound for $(\eps,\delta)$-differentially oblivious priority queues with $\varepsilon=O(1)$ and $\delta=o(1)$, which indicates that our construction is asymptotically optimal in terms of total work.

title: Optimal Approximation for Constrained Correlation Clustering via Repulsion
summary: The best-known approximation factor for constrained correlation clustering stood at three for nearly two decades, until a recent improvement to below $16/7$. We give a randomized polynomial-time $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation using \emph{Repulsion}, a recursive operation that separates a metric ball from its complement. Repulsion naturally respects hard constraints and admits a short potential-based analysis; as a warm-up, radius-$2/3$ Repulsion rounds the standard metric LP into a feasible partition of cost at most three times its objective. The $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximation takes a two-stage approach, first removing must-links with arbitrarily small loss in the approximation ratio. The second stage combines lossless, constraint-aware preclustering with the bounded sub-cluster LP framework of Cao, Cohen-Addad, Lee, Li, Newman, and Vogl (STOC 2024). Repeated positive conditioning and sampling produce candidate sets, which radius-one Repulsion partitions into feasible clusters at controlled cost. We also give an approximation-preserving reduction from vertex cover to cluster deletion, a special case with only cannot-links. Apart from establishing a matching factor-two hardness threshold under the Unique Games Conjecture, it motivates our two-stage approach and Repulsion.

title: Near-linear-Time Sampling of the Ferromagnetic Ising Model at the Tree Uniqueness Threshold
summary: We give a near-linear-time sampler for the zero-field ferromagnetic Ising model throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, including the threshold itself. The method also gives sampling algorithms for the XY and integer Potts models. On an $n$-vertex graph with $m$ edges and maximum degree at most $\Delta$, we obtain the following expected-work bounds, with total variation error at most $\varepsilon$. this http URL -linear Ising sampling. For $\Delta\ge3$, the work is $O(n+m\log^3(n/\varepsilon))$ throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, including the threshold $\beta=\Delta/(\Delta-2)$. this http URL -linear XY sampling. For $\Delta\ge8$, we sample the XY model in $\widetilde O(m+n^{1+o(1)})$ expected work at inverse-polynomial accuracy up to and including the robust phase-transition threshold on the $\Delta$-regular tree. this http URL -linear Potts sampling. For integer $q\ge3$, we sample the $q$-state Potts model in $\widetilde O(n+q^{O(1)}m)$ expected work whenever $\beta-1\le 0.1(\beta_{\mathrm{od}}(q,\Delta)-1)$, where $\beta_{\mathrm{od}}$ is the ordered/disordered coexistence parameter. We express the even-subgraph representation of critical Ising as a polymer model that admits near-linear-time sampling, thereby bypassing the critical slowdown of Glauber and Swendsen--Wang dynamics. Building on the low-degree approximation approach of Miao and Yin, we establish general spectral conditions for fast polymer sampling. We verify these conditions through explorations that also implement the sampler efficiently, and apply the same framework to flow representations of the XY and Potts models. We also establish polynomial-time counting and sampling for the ferromagnetic XY model at every fixed temperature.

title: Real-to-Integer Reduction for All-Pairs Shortest Paths
summary: Efficient graph algorithms often use techniques that are specific to integer-valued inputs and do not work for real-valued versions of the problems. Is it a limitation of current techniques, or are the real-valued variants inherently harder? One way to study this question is through real-to-integer reductions. We give (randomized, combinatorial) subcubic real-to-integer reductions for two central graph problems in fine-grained complexity: All-Pairs Shortest Paths and Exact Triangle. That is, we show that if the integer variants of these problems can be solved in truly subcubic time, then the real variants can also be solved in truly subcubic time. Our work extends and combines techniques from three previous works: (1) our real-to-integer reduction for the 3SUM problem (Fischer, Polak, Schmidt, FOCS 2026), which itself combines the Frank--Tardos theorem from optimization with Freiman's theorem from additive combinatorics; (2) universe reduction for APSP (Fischer, STOC 2026), which we generalize to reals and use to reduce the doubling of the set of edge weights; and (3) the ``Fredman's trick meets dominance product'' technique (Chan, Vassilevska Williams, Xu, STOC 2023), which is needed to adapt the prior real-to-integer framework from equality constraints to inequalities. As a corollary, our reduction combined with Yuval's fast Integer APSP algorithm in the real RAM model with multiplication (IPL 1976) shows that the Real APSP Hypothesis is false in this model, which also follows from the very recent breakthrough by Alman and Vassilevska Williams using a very different approach.

title: Faster Regular Expression Matching via Two-Dimensional Tabulation
summary: Regular expression matching asks whether a string of length $n$ belongs to the language described by a regular expression of length $m$. We give an algorithm that solves this problem in linear space and $O(nm \log \log n/\log^2 n + n + m)$ time. This improves the leading term of the previous best worst-case constant-alphabet time bound by a factor of $\sqrt{\log n}$. The key new technique is a two-dimensional tabulation specialized to the regular expression.

title: NP-Hardness and a PTAS for Maximum Interval Multicover, with Applications to Dense Subgraphs
summary: Given intervals and points on a line, each point with a demand, and a budget $K$, Maximum Interval Multicover asks for at most $K$ intervals that satisfy as many points as possible, a point being satisfied if it lies in at least as many chosen intervals as its demand. One application is committee elections in which each candidate is approved by consecutive voters and voters have individual demands. Xu, Ran and Zhang introduced the problem and gave a $1/2$-approximation; the objective is not submodular when demands exceed one. Li, Tu, Zhang and Cao gave a polynomial-time approximation scheme (PTAS) for the minimization counterpart, unweighted partial interval multicover, and asked for its complexity. We prove that both problems are NP-hard, even for intervals of equal length; as their optima are integers bounded by the input size, neither has a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$. We then give a PTAS for Maximum Interval Multicover, also for arbitrary nonnegative nondecreasing rewards for the coverage of each point. Building on a decomposition from Nonner's PTAS for Densest $k$-Subgraph on interval graphs, our scheme cuts the line into pieces at a small loss and solves every piece exactly. The key dynamic program handles intervals crossing a common point by choosing an interleaving of their left and right endpoints rather than sweeping along the line; it needs only two counters to track these intervals. The same algorithm yields PTASes on convex bipartite graphs for Bipartite Dense Subgraph, improving on the ratio $2/3$ of Backer and Keil for the subclass of bipartite permutation graphs, and on interval graphs for Maximum $k$-Vertex Cover and weighted clique counts.

title: Near-Linear Lower Bounds for Testing Directed Acyclicity
summary: We study testing acyclicity of directed graphs in the bounded-degree incidence-lists model, where a tester can query the outneighbors of a vertex but not its inneighbors. Despite significant effort, no tester with $o(n)$ queries is known, while the best established lower bounds are $\widetilde\Omega(n^{5/9})$ for one-sided testers (Chen, Randolph, Servedio, and Sun, 2022) and $\Omega(n^{1/3})$ for two-sided testers (Bender and Ron, 2002). We show that a query exponent arbitrarily close to one is necessary: for every fixed $\eta\in(0,1)$, there exists a constant $\varepsilon_\eta>0$ such that, for every constant $d\ge2$, every randomized adaptive two-sided $\varepsilon_\eta$-tester for acyclicity of simple $n$-vertex directed graphs whose indegrees and outdegrees are at most $d$ makes $\Omega(n^{1-\eta})$ queries. Our proof overcomes two barriers. First, in previous constructions, the acyclic part of the graph is easy to recognize, which helps an algorithm stay inside the cyclic part. We hide a high-girth cyclic core inside a hierarchy of acyclic masking regions, in which each region imitates the levels below it and can be told apart from them only through rare events, and an iterated information-theoretic argument shows that every exploration observes only small, low-diameter forest components of the core. Second, a two-sided tester may exploit the statistics of collisions without ever seeing a cycle, and at a near-linear budget collisions are unavoidable. We compare complete transcripts with those of an acyclic input built on a fixed core by counting injective embeddings of the observed forest: in high-girth cores, all connected collision patterns of bounded order contribute identically, which makes the two transcript distributions statistically indistinguishable.

title: Sorting in PRAM, Parallel Comparison Model and Parallel External Memory Model
summary: We study the problem of sorting on the Parallel Random Access Machine (PRAM), Parallel Comparison Model (PCM) and Parallel External Memory Model (PEM). On PRAM, we present a Concurrent Read Exclusive Write algorithm that runs in $O(\log n)$ time with $n$ processors; our algorithm is very different from Cole's Merge Sort. On PCM, we present the first optimal algorithm for sorting after AKS; our algorithm runs in $O(\log n/\log\alpha)$ comparison rounds with $n\alpha$ processors, for $1\leq\alpha\leq n$. On PEM, we present a Concurrent Read Exclusive Write algorithm that sorts $N$ elements in $O\left(\log\frac{N}{B}\right)$ I/O rounds with $p\geq \frac{N}{B}$ processors.

title: Metric Facility Location under Batched Random Order
summary: We study online metric facility location in the batched random-order model. An adversary partitions $n$ clients into $B$ nonempty batches, which arrive in uniformly random order. Each batch is revealed in full, and its clients must be connected to open facilities before the next batch arrives. Openings and assignments are irrevocable, and the objective is to minimize the total opening and connection cost. For both uniform and nonuniform opening costs, we prove that the tight competitive ratio is \[ \Theta\!\left(\min\left\{\log(B+1), \sqrt{\log(n-B+2)}\right\}\right). \] Thus, the ratio is constant both when there is a single batch and when every batch is a singleton, but intermediate numbers of batches can require a $\Theta(\sqrt{\log n})$ ratio. Our algorithms build on Meyerson's algorithm (2001) and do not need to know $n$ nor $B$. A key algorithmic novelty is that we process the clients in a batch one by one in uniform random order (hence neglecting the global properties of the batch). We present a novel analysis of this algorithm that hinges on the random order of the batches, as well as of the clients within each batch. We also provide a matching competitive ratio lower bound already for uniform costs, and even when the entire metric is known in advance.

title: Faster Planar Diameter using Pseudoline Envelopes
summary: We give an improved algorithm for weighted directed planar diameter that runs in $\widetilde{O}(n^{3/2})$ time. This improves upon the $\widetilde{O}(n^{5/3})$ time algorithm for weighted directed planar diameter of Gawrychowski, Kaplan, Mozes, Sharir, and Weimann [SIAM J. Comput. 2021] and the recent $\widetilde{O}(n^{8/5})$ time algorithm for unweighted undirected planar diameter of Fredslund-Hansen, Mozes, and Weimann [SOSA 2027]. The main new result is an improved data structure for computing the farthest vertex when given feasible planar distances to the vertices on the outer face. The critical insight is the fact that normalized distances to the vertices of a face behave like pseudolines, for which we can leverage range searching and upper envelope data structures. Using the farthest vertex data structure, we are able to compute all vertex eccentricities and diameter in $\widetilde{O}(n^{3/2})$.

title: Nearly-Linear Query Algorithm for Submodular Maximization subject to a Matroid Constraint
summary: We consider monotone submodular maximization subject to a matroid constraint. The seminal continuous greedy algorithm of Calinescu, Chekuri, Pál, and Vondrák~[SICOMP'11] achieves the tight approximation of $(1-1/e)$. Since then, a line of works by Badanidiyuru and Vondrák~[SODA'14], Buchbinder, Feldman, and Schwartz~[SODA'15 \& MOR'17], Kobayashi and Terao~[ICALP'24], Buchbinder and Feldman~[FOCS'24 \& SICOMP'25], and Buchbinder and Feldman~[STOC'25] has developed efficient $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithms for this problem. We present a combinatorial randomized $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm that requires $\tilde{O}_{\varepsilon}(n)$ independence-oracle and value-oracle queries, where $n$ is the number of elements in the matroid. This is the first $(1-1/e-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm with both independence-oracle and value-oracle query complexities nearly-linear in $n$ and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$. To achieve this, we develop a new local search algorithm, which we call \emph{protected local search}, based on the potential function of Buchbinder and Feldman~[FOCS'24 \& SICOMP'25].

title: Matchings under One-Sided Preferences with Soft Quotas
summary: Assigning applicants to posts in the presence of applicant preferences and quotas associated with posts is extensively investigated. For a post, a lower quota guarantees, and an upper quota limits the number of applicants assigned to it. Typically, quotas are assumed to be fixed, which need not be the case in practice. title: The Power of Interaction in Locally Edge-Private Subgraph Counting
summary: We study (non-induced) subgraph counting under interactive local edge differential privacy (LEDP). Given a fixed pattern graph $H$ with $k$ vertices, $\ell\ge1$ edges, and $q$ connected components, our goal is to approximately count its copies in an arbitrary $n$-vertex undirected graph while preserving edge privacy. We give two complementary accuracy guarantees. First, for every $H$, we give Linear Noise Cancellation (LNC), a two-round $\varepsilon$-LEDP algorithm with additive error and root mean square error both $O(n^{k-3/2}/\varepsilon^\ell)$ on every $n$-vertex graph. For fixed sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, this improves the optimal noninteractive additive error for triangles by a factor of $\sqrt n$ and gives the same improvement in worst-case root mean square error for all cliques on at least three vertices. To our knowledge, this is the first separation between interactive and noninteractive LEDP subgraph counting, showing that a single additional round can improve worst-case accuracy polynomially. Second, we determine how accuracy improves when the graph has maximum degree at most a public bound $d$. Our Predict and Correct (PC) framework gives an $(\ell+2)$-round $\varepsilon$-LEDP algorithm with additive error $O(n^{q-1/2}d^{k-q-1}\log^{3\ell-2}n/\varepsilon^\ell)$. For connected patterns, its polynomial factor is $\sqrt n\,d^{k-2}$, giving sublinear error on constant-degree graphs at fixed privacy. We prove matching lower bounds in $n$ and $d$, up to logarithmic factors at fixed privacy, even under arbitrary interaction and approximate privacy with sufficiently small $\delta$. At $d=\Theta(n)$, the lower bound also establishes the optimality of LNC's dependence on $n$.

title: Semi-Streaming Reachability and Shortest Paths in $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ Passes
summary: In the semi-streaming model, the edges of an $n$-vertex graph arrive in a stream, and an algorithm makes multiple passes over that stream while using only $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space. The number of passes needed to compute single-source reachability in directed graphs is a long-standing open question in streaming algorithms, going back to Henzinger, Raghavan, and Rajagopalan (1998). The best known semi-streaming algorithm uses $n^{1/2+o(1)}$ passes due to Jambulapati, Liu, and Sidford (2019), while the best lower bound is $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$ passes due to Guruswami and Onak (2016). We give streaming algorithms for computing single-source reachability and shortest paths on $n$-vertex directed graphs using $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space and $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ passes. Our algorithms are based on implicit hopsets, which are large hopsets that can be represented implicitly in $\widetilde{O}(n)$ space. We introduce this notion and give new constructions for implicit hopsets with small hopbound. Along the way, we obtain new work-depth tradeoffs for parallel shortest paths in directed graphs, improving the recent result of Ashvinkumar, Bernstein, Probst Gutenberg, and Saranurak (2026).

title: Finding Hypercliques Faster Than Brute Force
summary: We show that for any fixed $k$, there exists $\varepsilon_k > 0$ such that, given a $(k-1)$-uniform hypergraph $H$ on $n$ vertices, one can count the number of $k$-hypercliques in $H$ in $O(n^{k-\varepsilon_k})$ time. This refutes the hyperclique conjecture of Lincoln, Vassilevska Williams, and Williams (SODA 2018). Our result follows from the uniform construction of a family of arithmetic circuits of size $O(n^{k-\varepsilon_k})$ for the $k$-hyperclique tensor, a natural higher-order generalization of the matrix multiplication tensor. We obtain two corollaries. First, for every $k$, there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that Max-$k$SAT can be solved in $2^{(1-\varepsilon)n} \cdot \mathrm{poly}(m,n)$ time. Second, for every $k$, there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that arithmetic progressions of length $k$ in subsets of $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$ can be detected in $n^{2-\varepsilon}$ time. Both corollaries refute other prominent conjectures in the literature.

title: Recognizing Label-Connected Graphs
summary: In classical gossiping, each participant initially knows a distinct piece of information. Whenever two participants call each other, they exchange everything they know. We study Gossiping: given an undirected multigraph whose vertices represent participants and whose edges represent available calls, decide whether the calls can be ordered so that every participant learns all information, using each edge at most once. Equivalently, can one time label per edge make the graph temporally connected by strict temporal paths? This recognition problem is NP-complete; we study its parameterized complexity. After linear-time preprocessing, we give an exact $O(3^{n/3}n^3)$-time algorithm and a deterministic $2^{O(tw)}n$-time algorithm, where $n$ is the number of vertices and $tw$ is the treewidth of the underlying simple graph. We introduce a Tree Contraction Rule that extends the treewidth algorithm to single-exponential algorithms for parameters that may remain small on dense graphs, such as tree-independence number and clique-width, without requiring a decomposition as input. For the excess $\delta=m-(2n-4)$ over the minimum number of calls, where $m$ is the number of edges, we give a randomized $2^{O(\delta)}n^3$-time algorithm with one-sided error. Its main subroutine solves Rooted Independent Cycle: finding a cycle through four prescribed vertices whose edges are independent in a represented linear matroid. We solve this problem deterministically in $2^{O(r)}m$ arithmetic operations over the finite field representing the matroid, where $r$ is its rank. Gossiping is polynomial-time solvable at maximum degree four, counting parallel edges, but NP-complete on planar simple graphs of maximum degree five. The treewidth algorithm yields a $2^{O(\sqrt n)}$-time algorithm on planar graphs.

title: Path Decompositions of Sparse Graphs via Gaussian Sweeps and Faster Exponential Algorithms

summary: Using the bisection bound of Monien and Preis, Fomin and Høie proved in 2006 that every graph of maximum degree 3 on $n$ vertices has pathwidth at most $n/6+o(n)$. The path decompositions, and linear orderings of the stated cutwidth, can be computed in polynomial time. We bound the probability that a vertex lies in a frontier by comparison with an explicit Gaussian model of a vertex and its neighbors.
